"dist/config.js": "import { accessSync, constants, existsSync, readFileSync, realpathSync } from \"fs\";\nimport { homedir } from \"os\";\nimport { basename, dirname, join, resolve, sep, win32 } from \"path\";\nimport { fileURLToPath } from \"url\";\nimport { spawnProcessSync } from \"./utils/child-process.js\";\nimport { normalizePath } from \"./utils/paths.js\";\n// =============================================================================\n// Package Detection\n// =============================================================================\nconst __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);\nconst __dirname = dirname(__filename);\n/**\n * Detect if we're running as a Bun compiled binary.\n * Bun binaries have import.meta.url containing \"$bunfs\", \"~BUN\", or \"%7EBUN\" (Bun's virtual filesystem path)\n */\nexport const isBunBinary = import.meta.url.includes(\"$bunfs\") || import.meta.url.includes(\"~BUN\") || import.meta.url.includes(\"%7EBUN\");\n/** Detect if Bun is the runtime (compiled binary or bun run) */\nexport const isBunRuntime = !!process.versions.bun;\nfunction normalizeSelfUpdatePackageTarget(target) {\n    if (typeof target === \"string\") {\n        return { packageName: target, installSpec: target };\n    }\n    return { packageName: target.packageName, installSpec: target.installSpec ?? target.packageName };\n}\nfunction makeSelfUpdateCommand(installStep, uninstallStep) {\n    if (!uninstallStep)\n        return installStep;\n    return {\n        ...installStep,\n        display: `${uninstallStep.display} && ${installStep.display}`,\n        steps: [uninstallStep, installStep],\n    };\n}\nfunction makeSelfUpdateCommandStep(command, args) {\n    return {\n        command,\n        args,\n        display: [command, ...args].map((arg) => (/\\s/.test(arg) ? `\"${arg}\"` : arg)).join(\" \"),\n    };\n}\nexport function detectInstallMethod() {\n    if (isBunBinary) {\n        return \"bun-binary\";\n    }\n    const resolvedPath = `${__dirname}\\0${process.execPath || \"\"}`.toLowerCase().replace(/\\\\/g, \"/\");\n    if (resolvedPath.includes(\"/pnpm/\") || resolvedPath.includes(\"/.pnpm/\")) {\n        return \"pnpm\";\n    }\n    if (resolvedPath.includes(\"/yarn/\") || resolvedPath.includes(\"/.yarn/\")) {\n        return \"yarn\";\n    }\n    if (isBunRuntime || resolvedPath.includes(\"/install/global/node_modules/\")) {\n        return \"bun\";\n    }\n    if (resolvedPath.includes(\"/npm/\") || resolvedPath.includes(\"/node_modules/\")) {\n        return \"npm\";\n    }\n    return \"unknown\";\n}\nfunction getInferredNpmInstall() {\n    const packageDir = getPackageDir();\n    const path = process.platform === \"win32\" || packageDir.includes(\"\\\\\") ? win32 : { basename, dirname };\n    const parent = path.dirname(packageDir);\n    let root;\n    if (path.basename(parent).startsWith(\"@\") && path.basename(path.dirname(parent)) === \"node_modules\") {\n        root = path.dirname(parent);\n    }\n    else if (path.basename(parent) === \"node_modules\") {\n        root = parent;\n    }\n    if (!root)\n        return undefined;\n    const rootParent = path.dirname(root);\n    if (path.basename(rootParent) === \"lib\")\n        return { root, prefix: path.dirname(rootParent) };\n    // Windows global npm prefixes use `<prefix>\\\\node_modules`, which is\n    // indistinguishable from local project installs by path shape alone. Do not\n    // infer unsupported Windows custom prefixes without `npm root -g` evidence.\n    return undefined;\n}\nfunction getSelfUpdateCommandForMethod(method, installedPackageName, updatePackageTarget = installedPackageName, npmCommand) {\n    const target = normalizeSelfUpdatePackageTarget(updatePackageTarget);\n    switch (method) {\n        case \"bun-binary\":\n            return undefined;\n        case \"pnpm\": {\n            const match = readCommandOutput(\"pnpm\", [\"root\", \"-g\"])\n                ? undefined\n                : /^(.*[\\\\/]global[\\\\/][^\\\\/]+)[\\\\/]\\.pnpm[\\\\/]/.exec(getPackageDir());\n            const binDirArgs = match\n                ? [`--config.global-bin-dir=${process.env.PNPM_HOME || dirname(dirname(match[1]))}`]\n                : [];\n            return makeSelfUpdateCommand(makeSelfUpdateCommandStep(\"pnpm\", [\n                \"install\",\n                \"-g\",\n                \"--ignore-scripts\",\n                \"--config.minimumReleaseAge=0\",\n                ...binDirArgs,\n                target.installSpec,\n            ]), target.packageName === installedPackageName\n                ? undefined\n                : makeSelfUpdateCommandStep(\"pnpm\", [\"remove\", \"-g\", ...binDirArgs, installedPackageName]));\n        }\n        case \"yarn\":\n            return makeSelfUpdateCommand(makeSelfUpdateCommandStep(\"yarn\", [\"global\", \"add\", \"--ignore-scripts\", target.installSpec]), target.packageName === installedPackageName\n                ? undefined\n                : makeSelfUpdateCommandStep(\"yarn\", [\"global\", \"remove\", installedPackageName]));\n        case \"bun\":\n            return makeSelfUpdateCommand(makeSelfUpdateCommandStep(\"bun\", [\n                \"install\",\n                \"-g\",\n                \"--ignore-scripts\",\n                \"--minimum-release-age=0\",\n                target.installSpec,\n            ]), target.packageName === installedPackageName\n                ? undefined\n                : makeSelfUpdateCommandStep(\"bun\", [\"uninstall\", \"-g\", installedPackageName]));\n        case \"npm\": {\n            const [command = \"npm\", ...npmArgs] = npmCommand ?? [];\n            const inferred = npmCommand?.length ? undefined : getInferredNpmInstall();\n            const prefixArgs = [...npmArgs, ...(inferred ? [\"--prefix\", inferred.prefix] : [])];\n            const installStep = makeSelfUpdateCommandStep(command, [\n                ...prefixArgs,\n                \"install\",\n                \"-g\",\n                \"--ignore-scripts\",\n                \"--min-release-age=0\",\n                target.installSpec,\n            ]);\n            const uninstallStep = target.packageName === installedPackageName\n                ? undefined\n                : makeSelfUpdateCommandStep(command, [...prefixArgs, \"uninstall\", \"-g\", installedPackageName]);\n            return makeSelfUpdateCommand(installStep, uninstallStep);\n        }\n        case \"unknown\":\n            return undefined;\n    }\n}\nfunction readCommandOutput(command, args, options = {}) {\n    const result = spawnProcessSync(command, args, {\n        encoding: \"utf-8\",\n        stdio: [\"ignore\", \"pipe\", \"pipe\"],\n    });\n    if (result.status === 0)\n        return result.stdout.trim() || undefined;\n    if (options.requireSuccess) {\n        const reason = result.error?.message || result.stderr.trim() || `exit code ${result.status ?? \"unknown\"}`;\n        throw new Error(`Failed to run ${[command, ...args].join(\" \")}: ${reason}`);\n    }\n    return undefined;\n}\nfunction getGlobalPackageRoots(method, _packageName, npmCommand) {\n    switch (method) {\n        case \"npm\": {\n            const configured = !!npmCommand?.length;\n            const [command = \"npm\", ...npmArgs] = npmCommand ?? [];\n            if (configured && command === \"bun\") {\n                const bunBin = readCommandOutput(command, [...npmArgs, \"pm\", \"bin\", \"-g\"], {\n                    requireSuccess: true,\n                });\n                const roots = [join(homedir(), \".bun\", \"install\", \"global\", \"node_modules\")];\n                if (bunBin) {\n                    roots.push(join(dirname(bunBin), \"install\", \"global\", \"node_modules\"));\n                }\n                return roots;\n            }\n            const root = readCommandOutput(command, [...npmArgs, \"root\", \"-g\"], {\n                requireSuccess: configured,\n            });\n            const inferred = configured ? undefined : getInferredNpmInstall();\n            return [root, inferred?.root].filter((x) => !!x);\n        }\n        case \"pnpm\": {\n            const root = readCommandOutput(\"pnpm\", [\"root\", \"-g\"]);\n            if (root)\n                return [root, dirname(root)];\n            const match = /^(.*[\\\\/]global[\\\\/][^\\\\/]+)[\\\\/]\\.pnpm[\\\\/]/.exec(getPackageDir());\n            return match ? [match[1]] : [];\n        }\n        case \"yarn\": {\n            const dir = readCommandOutput(\"yarn\", [\"global\", \"dir\"]);\n            return dir ? [dir, join(dir, \"node_modules\")] : [];\n        }\n        case \"bun\": {\n            const bunBin = readCommandOutput(\"bun\", [\"pm\", \"bin\", \"-g\"]);\n            const roots = [join(homedir(), \".bun\", \"install\", \"global\", \"node_modules\")];\n            if (bunBin) {\n                roots.push(join(dirname(bunBin), \"install\", \"global\", \"node_modules\"));\n            }\n            return roots;\n        }\n        case \"bun-binary\":\n        case \"unknown\":\n            return [];\n    }\n}\nfunction normalizeExistingPathForComparison(path, resolveSymlinks) {\n    const resolvedPath = resolve(path);\n    if (!existsSync(resolvedPath)) {\n        return undefined;\n    }\n    let normalizedPath = resolvedPath;\n    if (resolveSymlinks) {\n        try {\n            normalizedPath = realpathSync(resolvedPath);\n        }\n        catch {\n            return undefined;\n        }\n    }\n    if (process.platform === \"win32\") {\n        normalizedPath = normalizedPath.toLowerCase();\n    }\n    return normalizedPath;\n}\nfunction getPathComparisonCandidates(path) {\n    return Array.from(new Set([normalizeExistingPathForComparison(path, false), normalizeExistingPathForComparison(path, true)].filter((candidate) => !!candidate)));\n}\nfunction getEntrypointPackageDir() {\n    const entrypoint = process.argv[1];\n    if (!entrypoint)\n        return undefined;\n    let dir = dirname(entrypoint);\n    while (dir !== dirname(dir)) {\n        if (existsSync(join(dir, \"package.json\"))) {\n            return dir;\n        }\n        dir = dirname(dir);\n    }\n    return undefined;\n}\nfunction isSelfUpdatePathWritable() {\n    const packageDir = getPackageDir();\n    try {\n        accessSync(packageDir, constants.W_OK);\n        accessSync(dirname(packageDir), constants.W_OK);\n        return true;\n    }\n    catch {\n        return false;\n    }\n}\nfunction isManagedByGlobalPackageManager(method, packageName, npmCommand) {\n    const packageDirs = [getPackageDir(), getEntrypointPackageDir()].filter((dir) => !!dir);\n    const packageDirCandidates = packageDirs.flatMap((dir) => getPathComparisonCandidates(dir));\n    return getGlobalPackageRoots(method, packageName, npmCommand).some((root) => {\n        return getPathComparisonCandidates(root).some((normalizedRoot) => {\n            const rootPrefix = normalizedRoot.endsWith(sep) ? normalizedRoot : `${normalizedRoot}${sep}`;\n            return packageDirCandidates.some((packageDir) => packageDir.startsWith(rootPrefix));\n        });\n    });\n}\nexport function getSelfUpdateCommand(packageName, npmCommand, updatePackageTarget = packageName) {\n    const method = detectInstallMethod();\n    const command = getSelfUpdateCommandForMethod(method, packageName, updatePackageTarget, npmCommand);\n    if (!command || !isManagedByGlobalPackageManager(method, packageName, npmCommand) || !isSelfUpdatePathWritable()) {\n        return undefined;\n    }\n    return command;\n}\nexport function getSelfUpdateUnavailableInstruction(packageName, npmCommand, updatePackageTarget = packageName) {\n    const method = detectInstallMethod();\n    const target = normalizeSelfUpdatePackageTarget(updatePackageTarget);\n    if (method === \"bun-binary\") {\n        return `Download from: https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-mono/releases/latest`;\n    }\n    const command = getSelfUpdateCommandForMethod(method, packageName, target, npmCommand);\n    if (command) {\n        if (isManagedByGlobalPackageManager(method, packageName, npmCommand) && !isSelfUpdatePathWritable()) {\n            return `This installation is managed by a global ${method} install, but the install path is not writable. Update it yourself with: ${command.display}`;\n        }\n        return `This installation is not managed by a global ${method} install. Update it with the package manager, wrapper, or source checkout that provides it.`;\n    }\n    return `Update ${target.installSpec} using the package manager, wrapper, or source checkout that provides this installation.`;\n}\nexport function getUpdateInstruction(packageName) {\n    const method = detectInstallMethod();\n    const command = getSelfUpdateCommandForMethod(method, packageName);\n    if (command) {\n        return `Run: ${command.display}`;\n    }\n    return getSelfUpdateUnavailableInstruction(packageName);\n}\n// =============================================================================\n// Package Asset Paths (shipped with executable)\n// =============================================================================\n/**\n * Get the base directory for resolving package assets (themes, package.json, README.md, CHANGELOG.md).\n * - For Bun binary: returns the directory containing the executable\n * - For Node.js (dist/): returns __dirname (the dist/ directory)\n * - For tsx (src/): returns parent directory (the package root)\n */\nexport function getPackageDir() {\n    // Allow override via environment variable (useful for Nix/Guix where store paths tokenize poorly)\n    const envDir = process.env.PI_PACKAGE_DIR;\n    if (envDir) {\n        return normalizePath(envDir);\n    }\n    if (isBunBinary) {\n        // Bun binary: process.execPath points to the compiled executable\n        return dirname(process.execPath);\n    }\n    // Node.js: walk up from __dirname until we find package.json\n    let dir = __dirname;\n    while (dir !== dirname(dir)) {\n        if (existsSync(join(dir, \"package.json\"))) {\n            return dir;\n        }\n        dir = dirname(dir);\n    }\n    // Fallback (shouldn't happen)\n    return __dirname;\n}\n/**\n * Get path to built-in themes directory (shipped with package)\n * - Removed when delivered. */\n    _followUpMessages = [];\n    /** Messages queued to be included with the next user prompt as context (\"asides\"). */\n    _pendingNextTurnMessages = [];\n    // Compaction state\n    _compactionAbortController = undefined;\n    _autoCompactionAbortController = undefined;\n    _overflowRecoveryAttempted = false;\n    // Branch summarization state\n    _branchSummaryAbortController = undefined;\n    // Retry state\n    _retryAbortController = undefined;\n    _retryAttempt = 0;\n    // Bash execution state\n    _bashAbortControllers = new Set();\n    _pendingBashMessages = [];\n    // Extension system\n    _extensionRunner;\n    _turnIndex = 0;\n    _resourceLoader;\n    _customTools;\n    _baseToolDefinitions = new Map();\n    _cwd;\n    _extensionRunnerRef;\n    _initialActiveToolNames;\n    _allowedToolNames;\n    _excludedToolNames;\n    _baseToolsOverride;\n    _sessionStartEvent;\n    _extensionUIContext;\n    _extensionMode = \"print\";\n    _extensionCommandContextActions;\n    _extensionAbortHandler;\n    _extensionShutdownHandler;\n    _extensionErrorListener;\n    _extensionErrorUnsubscriber;\n    _modelRuntime;\n    // Tool registry for extension getTools/setTools\n    _toolRegistry = new Map();\n    _toolDefinitions = new Map();\n    _toolPromptSnippets = new Map();\n    _toolPromptGuidelines = new Map();\n    // Base system prompt (without extension appends) - used to apply fresh appends each turn\n    _baseSystemPrompt = \"\";\n    _baseSystemPromptOptions;\n    _systemPromptOverride;\n    constructor(config) {\n        this.agent = config.agent;\n        this.sessionManager = config.sessionManager;\n        this.settingsManager = config.settingsManager;\n        this._scopedModels = config.scopedModels ?? [];\n        this._resourceLoader = config.resourceLoader;\n        this._customTools = config.customTools ?? [];\n        this._cwd = config.cwd;\n        this._modelRuntime = config.modelRuntime;\n        this._extensionRunnerRef = config.extensionRunnerRef;\n        this._initialActiveToolNames = config.initialActiveToolNames;\n        this._allowedToolNames = config.allowedToolNames ? error.cause : undefined;\n            if (cause instanceof Error && cause.message === \"authHeader requires a resolved API key\") {\n                throw new Error(formatNoApiKeyFoundMessage(model.provider));\n            }\n            throw error;\n        }\n        if (result && (result.auth.apiKey || result.auth.headers)) {\n            const requestModel = result.auth.baseUrl ? { ...model, baseUrl: result.auth.baseUrl } : model;\n            return {\n                model: requestModel,\n                apiKey: result.auth.apiKey,\n                headers: withoutDeletedHeaders(result.auth.headers),\n                env: result.env,\n            };\n        }\n        const isOAuth = this._modelRuntime.isUsingOAuth(model.provider);\n        if (isOAuth) {\n            throw new Error(`Authentication failed for \"${model.provider}\". ` +\n                `Credentials may have expired or network is unavailable. ` +\n                `Run '/login ${model.provider}' to re-authenticate.`);\n        }\n        throw new Error(formatNoApiKeyFoundMessage(model.provider));\n    }\n    async _getSummarizationRequestAuth(model) {\n        if (this.agent.streamFunction === streamSimple) {\n            return this._getRequiredRequestAuth(model);\n        }\n        try {\n            const result = await this._modelRuntime.getAuth(model);\n            if (!result)\n                return { model };\n            const requestModel = result.auth.baseUrl ? { ...model, baseUrl: result.auth.baseUrl } : model;\n            return {\n                model: requestModel,\n                apiKey: result.auth.apiKey,\n                headers: withoutDeletedHeaders(result.auth.headers),\n                env: result.env,\n            };\n        }\n        catch {\n            return { model };\n        }\n    }\n    /**\n     * Install tool hooks once on the Agent instance.\n     *\n     * The callbacks read `this._extensionRunner` at execution time, so extension reload swaps in the\n     * new runner without reinstalling hooks. Extension-specific tool wrappers are still used to adapt\n     * registered tool execution to the extension context. Tool call and tool result interception now\n     * happens here instead of in wrappers.\n     */\n    _installAgentToolHooks() {\n        this.agent.beforeToolCall = async ({ toolCall, args }) => {\n            const runner = this._extensionRunner;\n            if (!runner.hasHandlers(\"tool_call\")) {\n                return undefined;\n            }\n            try {\n                return await runner.emitToolCall({\n                    type: \"tool_call\",\n                    toolName: toolCall.name,\n                    toolCallId: toolCall.id,\n                    input: args,\n                });\n            }\n            catch (err) {\n                if (err instanceof Error) {\n                    throw err;\n                }\n                throw new Error(`Extension failed, blocking execution: ${String(err)}`);\n            }\n        };\n        this.agent.afterToolCall = async ({ toolCall, args, result, isError }) => {\n            const runner = this._extensionRunner;\n            const hookResult = runner.hasHandlers(\"tool_result\")\n                ? await runner.emitToolResult({\n                    type: \"tool_result\",\n                    toolName: toolCall.name,\n                    toolCallId: toolCall.id,\n                    input: args,\n                    content: result.content,\n                    details: result.details,\n                    isError,\n                    usage: result.usage,\n                })\n                : undefined;\n            const content = hookResult?.content ?? result.content ?? [];\n            // Runs after the extension hook so images injected or replaced by extensions are normalized too.\n            const normalizedContent = await normalizeToolResultImages(content, {\n                autoResizeImages: this.settingsManager.getImageAutoResize(),\n            });\n            if (!hookResult && normalizedContent === content) {\n                return undefined;\n            }\n            return {\n                content: normalizedContent,\n                details: hookResult?.details,\n                isError: hookResult?.isError ?? isError,\n                usage: hookResult?.usage,\n            };\n        };\n    }\n    _installAgentNextTurnRefresh() {\n        const previousPrepareNextTurnWithContext = this.agent.prepareNextTurnWithContext ??\n            (this.agent.prepareNextTurn\n                ? async (_turn, signal) => await this.agent.prepareNextTurn?.(signal)\n                : undefined);\n        this.agent.prepareNextTurnWithContext = async (turn, signal) => {\n            const previousSnapshot = await previousPrepareNextTurnWithContext?.(turn, signal);\n            const previousContext = previousSnapshot?.context ?? turn.context;\n            return {\n                ...previousSnapshot,\n                context: {\n                    ...previousContext,\n                    systemPrompt: this._systemPromptOverride ?? this._baseSystemPrompt,\n                    tools: this.agent.state.tools.slice(),\n                },\n                model: this.agent.state.model,\n                thinkingLevel: this.agent.state.thinkingLevel,\n            };\n        };\n    }\n    // =========================================================================\n    // Event Subscription\n    // =========================================================================\n    /** Emit an event to all listeners */\n    _emit(event) {\n        for (const l of this._eventListeners) {\n            l(event);\n        }\n    }\n    _emitQueueUpdate() {\n        this._emit({\n            type: \"queue_update\",\n            steering: [...this._steeringMessages],\n            followUp: [...this._followUpMessages],\n        });\n    }\n    _getIdleWaitPromise() {\n        if (!this._idleWaitPromise) {\n            this._idleWaitPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n                this._resolveIdleWait = resolve;\n            });\n        }\n        return this._idleWaitPromise;\n    }\n    _resolveIdleWaitIfIdle() {\n        if (this._isAgentRunActive || !this._resolveIdleWait) {\n            return;\n        }\n        const resolve = this._resolveIdleWait;\n        this._idleWaitPromise = undefined;\n        this._resolveIdleWait = undefined;\n        resolve();\n    }\n    async _emitAgentSettled() {\n        this._isAgentRunActive = false;\n        try {\n            await this._extensionRunner.emit({ type: \"agent_settled\" });\n            this._emit({ type: \"agent_settled\" });\n        }\n        finally {\n            this._resolveIdleWaitIfIdle();\n        }\n    }\n    // Track last assistant message for auto-compaction check\n    _lastAssistantMessage = undefined;\n    /** Internal handler for agent events - shared by subscribe and reconnect */\n    _handleAgentEvent = async (event) => {\n        // When a user message starts, check if it's from either queue and remove it BEFORE emitting\n        // This ensures the UI sees the updated queue state\n        if (event.type === \"message_start\" && event.message.role === \"user\") {\n            this._overflowRecoveryAttempted = false;\n            const messageText = contentText(event.message.content, \"\");\n            if (messageText) {\n                // Check steering queue first\n                const steeringIndex = this._steeringMessages.indexOf(messageText);\n                if (steeringIndex !== -1) {\n                    this._steeringMessages.splice(steeringIndex, 1);\n                    this._emitQueueUpdate();\n                }\n                else {\n                    // Check follow-up queue\n                    const followUpIndex = this._followUpMessages.indexOf(messageText);\n                    if (followUpIndex !== -1) {\n                        this._followUpMessages.splice(followUpIndex, 1);\n                        this._emitQueueUpdate();\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        // Emit to extensions first\n        await this._emitExtensionEvent(event);\n        // Notify all listeners\n        this._emit(event.type === \"agent_end\" ? { ...event, willRetry: this._willRetryAfterAgentEnd(event) } : event);\n        // Handle session persistence\n        if (event.type === \"message_end\") {\n            // Check if this is a custom message from extensions\n            if (event.message.role === \"custom\") {\n                // Persist as CustomMessageEntry\n                this.sessionManager.appendCustomMessageEntry(event.message.customType, event.message.content, event.message.display, event.message.details);\n            }\n            else if (event.message.role === \"user\" ||\n                event.message.role === \"assistant\" ||\n                event.message.role === \"toolResult\") {\n                // Regular LLM message - persist as SessionMessageEntry\n                this.sessionManager.appendMessage(event.message);\n            }\n            // Other message types (bashExecution, compactionSummary, branchSummary) are persisted elsewhere\n            // Track assistant message for auto-compaction (checked on agent_end)\n            if (event.message.role === \"assistant\") {\n                this._lastAssistantMessage = event.message;\n                const assistantMsg = event.message;\n                if (assistantMsg.stopReason !== \"error\" && assistantMsg.stopReason !== \"length\") {\n                    this._overflowRecoveryAttempted = false;\n                }\n                // Reset retry counter immediately on successful assistant response\n                // This prevents accumulation across multiple LLM calls within a turn\n                if (assistantMsg.stopReason !== \"error\" && this._retryAttempt > 0) {\n                    this._emit({\n                        type: \"auto_retry_end\",\n                        success: true,\n                        attempt: this._retryAttempt,\n                    });\n                    this._retryAttempt = 0;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    };\n    _willRetryAfterAgentEnd(event) {\n        const settings = this.settingsManager.getRetrySettings();\n        if (!settings.enabled || this._retryAttempt >= settings.maxRetries) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        for (let i = event.messages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {\n            const message = event.messages[i];\n            if (message.role === \"assistant\") {\n                return this._isRetryableError(message);\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n    /** Find the last assistant message in agent state (including aborted ones) */\n    _findLastAssistantMessage() {\n        const messages = this.agent.state.messages;\n        for (let i = messages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {\n            const msg = messages[i];\n            if (msg.role === \"assistant\") {\n                return msg;\n            }\n        }\n        return undefined;\n    }\n    _replaceMessageInPlace(target, replacement) {\n        // Agent-core stores the finalized message object in its state before emitting message_end.\n        // SessionManager persistence happens later in _handleAgentEvent() with event.message.\n        // Mutating this object in place keeps agent state, later turn/agent events, listeners,\n        // and the eventual SessionManager.appendMessage(event.message) persistence in sync.\n        if (target === replacement) {\n            return;\n        }\n        const targetRecord = target;\n        for (const key of Object.keys(targetRecord)) {\n            delete targetRecord[key];\n        }\n        Object.assign(targetRecord, replacement);\n    }\n    /** Emit extension events based on agent events */\n    async _emitExtensionEvent(event) {\n        if (event.type === \"agent_start\") {\n            this._turnIndex = 0;\n            await this._extensionRunner.emit({ type: \"agent_start\" });\n        }\n        else if (event.type === \"agent_end\") {\n            await this._extensionRunner.emit({ type: \"agent_end\", messages: event.messages });\n        }\n        else if (event.type === \"turn_start\") {\n            const extensionEvent = {\n                type: \"turn_start\",\n                turnIndex: this._turnIndex,\n                timestamp: Date.now(),\n            };\n            await this._extensionRunner.emit(extensionEvent);\n        }\n        else if (event.type === \"turn_end\") {\n            const extensionEvent = {\n                type: \"turn_end\",\n                turnIndex: this._turnIndex,\n                message: event.message,\n                toolResults: event.toolResults,\n            };\n            await this._extensionRunner.emit(extensionEvent);\n            this._turnIndex++;\n        }\n        else if (event.type === \"message_start\") {\n            const extensionEvent = {\n                type: \"message_start\",\n                message: event.message,\n            };\n            await this._extensionRunner.emit(extensionEvent);\n        }\n        else if (event.type === \"message_update\") {\n            const extensionEvent = {\n                type: \"message_update\",\n                message: event.message,\n                assistantMessageEvent: event.assistantMessageEvent,\n            };\n            await this._extensionRunner.emit(extensionEvent);\n        }\n        else if (event.type === \"message_end\") {\n            const extensionEvent = {\n                type: \"message_end\",\n                message: event.message,\n            };\n            const replacement = await this._extensionRunner.emitMessageEnd(extensionEvent);\n            if (replacement) {\n                // Untyped extension handlers can return messages with null/missing content;\n                // normalize so it never enters agent state or session history.\n                const normalized = (replacement.role === \"user\" ||\n                    replacement.role === \"assistant\" ||\n                    replacement.role === \"toolResult\" ||\n                    replacement.role === \"custom\") &&\n                    replacement.content == null\n                    ? { ...replacement, content: [] }\n                    : replacement;\n                this._replaceMessageInPlace(event.message, normalized);\n            }\n        }\n        else if (event.type === \"tool_execution_start\") {\n            const extensionEvent = {\n                type: \"tool_execution_start\",\n                toolCallId: event.toolCallId,\n                toolName: event.toolName,\n                args: event.args,\n            };\n            await this._extensionRunner.emit(extensionEvent);\n        }\n        else if (event.type === \"tool_execution_update\") {\n            const extensionEvent = {\n                type: \"tool_execution_update\",\n                toolCallId: event.toolCallId,\n                toolName: event.toolName,\n                args: event.args,\n                partialResult: event.partialResult,\n            };\n            await this._extensionRunner.emit(extensionEvent);\n        }\n        else if (event.type === \"tool_execution_end\") {\n            const extensionEvent = {\n                type: \"tool_execution_end\",\n                toolCallId: event.toolCallId,\n                toolName: event.toolName,\n                result: event.result,\n                isError: event.isError,\n            };\n            await this._extensionRunner.emit(extensionEvent);\n        }\n    }\n    /**\n     * Subscribe to agent events.\n     * Session persistence is handled internally (saves messages on message_end).\n     * Multiple listeners can be added. Returns unsubscribe function for this listener.\n     */\n    subscribe(listener) {\n        this._eventListeners.push(listener);\n        // Return unsubscribe function for this specific listener\n        return () => {\n            const index = this._eventListeners.indexOf(listener);\n            if (index !== -1) {\n                this._eventListeners.splice(index, 1);\n            }\n        };\n    }\n    /** Disconnect from agent events during disposal. */\n    _disconnectFromAgent() {\n        if (this._unsubscribeAgent) {\n            this._unsubscribeAgent();\n            this._unsubscribeAgent = undefined;\n        }\n    }\n    /**\n     * Remove all listeners and disconnect from agent.\n     * Call this when completely done with the session.\n     */\n    dispose() {\n        try {\n            this.abortRetry();\n            this.abortCompaction();\n            this.abortBranchSummary();\n            this.abortBash();\n            this.agent.abort();\n        }\n        catch {\n            // Dispose must succeed even if an abort hook throws.\n        }\n        this._extensionRunner.invalidate(\"This extension ctx is stale after session replacement or reload. Do not use a captured pi or command ctx after ctx.newSession(), ctx.fork(), ctx.switchSession(), or ctx.reload(). For newSession, fork, and switchSession, move post-replacement work into withSession and use the ctx passed to withSession. For reload, do not use the old ctx after await ctx.reload().\");\n        this._disconnectFromAgent();\n        this._eventListeners = [];\n        cleanupSessionResources(this.sessionId);\n    }\n    // =========================================================================\n    // Read-only State Access\n    // =========================================================================\n    /** Full agent state */\n    get state() {\n        return this.agent.state;\n    }\n    /** Current model (may be undefined if not yet selected) */\n    get model() {\n        return this.agent.state.model;\n    }\n    /** Current thinking level */\n    get thinkingLevel() {\n        return this.agent.state.thinkingLevel;\n    }\n    /** Whether the session is currently processing an agent run or post-run continuation. */\n    get isStreaming() {\n        return this._isAgentRunActive;\n    }\n    /** Whether the session has no active agent run, retry, auto-compaction, or queued continuation. */\n    get isIdle() {\n        return !this._isAgentRunActive;\n    }\n    /** Current effective system prompt (includes any per-turn extension modifications) */\n    get systemPrompt() {\n        return this.agent.state.systemPrompt;\n    }\n    /** Current retry attempt (0 if not retrying) */\n    get retryAttempt() {\n        return this._retryAttempt;\n    }\n    /**\n     * Get the names of currently active tools.\n     * Returns the names of tools currently set on the agent.\n     */\n    getActiveToolNames() {\n        return this.agent.state.tools.map((t) => t.name);\n    }\n    /**\n     * Get all configured tools with name, description, parameter schema, prompt guidelines, and source metadata.\n     */\n    getAllTools() {\n        return Array.from(this._toolDefinitions.values()).map(({ definition, sourceInfo }) => ({\n            name: definition.name,\n            description: definition.description,\n            parameters: definition.parameters,\n            promptGuidelines: definition.promptGuidelines,\n            sourceInfo,\n        }));\n    }\n    getToolDefinition(name) {\n        return this._toolDefinitions.get(name)?.definition;\n    }\n    /**\n     * Set active tools by name.\n     * Only tools in the registry can be enabled. Unknown tool names are ignored.\n     * Also rebuilds the system prompt to reflect the new tool set.\n     * Changes take effect on the next agent turn.\n     */\n    setActiveToolsByName(toolNames) {\n        const tools = [];\n        const validToolNames = [];\n        for (const name of toolNames) {\n            const tool = this._toolRegistry.get(name);\n            if (tool) {\n                tools.push(tool);\n                validToolNames.push(name);\n            }\n        }\n        this.agent.state.tools = tools;\n        // Rebuild base system prompt with new tool set\n        this._baseSystemPrompt = this._rebuildSystemPrompt(validToolNames);\n        this.agent.state.systemPrompt = this._systemPromptOverride ?? this._baseSystemPrompt;\n    }\n    /** Whether compaction or branch summarization is currently running */\n    get isCompacting() {\n        return (this._autoCompactionAbortController !== undefined ||\n            this._compactionAbortController !== undefined ||\n            this._branchSummaryAbortController !== undefined);\n    }\n    /** All messages including custom types like BashExecutionMessage */\n    get messages() {\n        return this.agent.state.messages;\n    }\n    /** Current steering mode */\n    get steeringMode() {\n        return this.agent.steeringMode;\n    }\n    /** Current follow-up mode */\n    get followUpMode() {\n        return this.agent.followUpMode;\n    }\n    /** Current session file path, or undefined if sessions are disabled */\n    get sessionFile() {\n        return this.sessionManager.getSessionFile();\n    }\n    /** Current session ID */\n    get sessionId() {\n        return this.sessionManager.getSessionId();\n    }\n    /** Current session display name, if set */\n    get sessionName() {\n        return this.sessionManager.getSessionName();\n    }\n    /** Scoped models for cycling (from --models flag) */\n    get scopedModels() {\n        return this._scopedModels;\n    }\n    /** Update scoped models for cycling */\n    setScopedModels(scopedModels) {\n        this._scopedModels = scopedModels;\n    }\n    /** File-based prompt templates */\n    get promptTemplates() {\n        return this._resourceLoader.getPrompts().prompts;\n    }\n    _normalizePromptSnippet(text) {\n        if (!text)\n            return undefined;\n        const oneLine = text\n            .replace(/[\\r\\n]+/g, \" \")\n            .replace(/\\s+/g, \" \")\n            .trim();\n        return oneLine.length > 0 ? oneLine : undefined;\n    }\n    _normalizePromptGuidelines(guidelines) {\n        if (!guidelines || guidelines.length === 0) {\n            return [];\n        }\n        const unique = new Set();\n        for (const guideline of guidelines) {\n            const normalized = guideline.trim();\n            if (normalized.length > 0) {\n                unique.add(normalized);\n            }\n        }\n        return Array.from(unique);\n    }\n    _rebuildSystemPrompt(toolNames) {\n        const validToolNames = toolNames.filter((name) => this._toolRegistry.has(name));\n        const toolSnippets = {};\n        const promptGuidelines = [];\n        for (const name of validToolNames) {\n            const snippet = this._toolPromptSnippets.get(name);\n            if (snippet) {\n                toolSnippets[name] = snippet;\n            }\n            const toolGuidelines = this._toolPromptGuidelines.get(name);\n            if (toolGuidelines) {\n                promptGuidelines.push(...toolGuidelines);\n            }\n        }\n        const loaderSystemPrompt = this._resourceLoader.getSystemPrompt();\n        const loaderAppendSystemPrompt = this._resourceLoader.getAppendSystemPrompt();\n        const appendSystemPrompt = loaderAppendSystemPrompt.length > 0 ? loaderAppendSystemPrompt.join(\"\\n\\n\") : undefined;\n        const loadedSkills = this._resourceLoader.getSkills().skills;\n        const loadedContextFiles = this._resourceLoader.getAgentsFiles().agentsFiles;\n        this._baseSystemPromptOptions = {\n            cwd: this._cwd,\n            skills: loadedSkills,\n            contextFiles: loadedContextFiles,\n            customPrompt: loaderSystemPrompt,\n            appendSystemPrompt,\n            selectedTools: validToolNames,\n            toolSnippets,\n            promptGuidelines,\n        };\n        return buildSystemPrompt(this._baseSystemPromptOptions);\n    }\n    // =========================================================================\n    // Prompting\n    // =========================================================================\n    async _runAgentPrompt(messages) {\n        this._isAgentRunActive = true;\n        try {\n            await this.agent.prompt(messages);\n            while (await this._handlePostAgentRun()) {\n                await this.agent.continue();\n            }\n        }\n        finally {\n            this._systemPromptOverride = undefined;\n            this._flushPendingBashMessages();\n            await this._emitAgentSettled();\n        }\n    }\n    async _handlePostAgentRun() {\n        const msg = this._lastAssistantMessage;\n        this._lastAssistantMessage = undefined;\n        if (!msg) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (this._isRetryableError(msg) && (await this._prepareRetry(msg))) {\n            return true;\n        }\n        if (msg.stopReason === \"error\" && this._retryAttempt > 0) {\n            this._emit({\n                type: \"auto_retry_end\",\n                success: false,\n                attempt: this._retryAttempt,\n                finalError: msg.errorMessage,\n            });\n            this._retryAttempt = 0;\n        }\n        if (await this._checkCompaction(msg)) {\n            return true;\n        }\n        // The agent loop drains both queues before emitting agent_end. Any messages\n        // here were queued by agent_end extension handlers and need a continuation.\n        return this.agent.hasQueuedMessages();\n    }\n    /**\n     * Send a prompt to the agent.\n     * - Handles extension commands (registered via pi.registerCommand) immediately, even during streaming\n     * - Expands file-based prompt templates by default\n     * - During streaming, queues via steer() or followUp() based on streamingBehavior option\n     * - Validates model and API key before sending (when not streaming)\n     * @throws Error if streaming and no streamingBehavior specified\n     * @throws Error if no model selected or no API key available (when not streaming)\n     */\n    async prompt(text, options) {\n        const expandPromptTemplates = options?.expandPromptTemplates ?? true;\n        const preflightResult = options?.preflightResult;\n        let messages;\n        try {\n            // Handle extension commands first (execute immediately, even during streaming)\n            // Extension commands manage their own LLM interaction via pi.sendMessage()\n            if (expandPromptTemplates && text.startsWith(\"/\")) {\n                const handled = await this._tryExecuteExtensionCommand(text);\n                if (handled) {\n                    // Extension command executed, no prompt to send\n                    preflightResult?.(true);\n                    return;\n                }\n            }\n            if (this._compactionAbortController !== undefined) {\n                throw new Error(\"Cannot submit a prompt while compaction is in progress. Wait for compaction to finish and retry.\");\n            }\n            // Emit input event for extension interception (before skill/template expansion)\n            let currentText = text;\n            let currentImages = options?.images;\n            if (this._extensionRunner.hasHandlers(\"input\")) {\n                const inputResult = await this._extensionRunner.emitInput(currentText, currentImages, options?.source ?? \"interactive\", this.isStreaming ? options?.streamingBehavior : undefined);\n                if (inputResult.action === \"handled\") {\n                    preflightResult?.(true);\n                    return;\n                }\n                if (inputResult.action === \"transform\") {\n                    currentText = inputResult.text;\n                    currentImages = inputResult.images ?? currentImages;\n                }\n            }\n            // Expand skill commands (/skill:name args) and prompt templates (/template args)\n            let expandedText = currentText;\n            if (expandPromptTemplates) {\n                expandedText = this._expandSkillCommand(expandedText);\n                expandedText = expandPromptTemplate(expandedText, [...this.promptTemplates]);\n            }\n            // If streaming, queue via steer() or followUp() based on option\n            if (this.isStreaming) {\n                if (!options?.streamingBehavior) {\n                    throw new Error(\"Agent is already processing. Specify streamingBehavior ('steer' or 'followUp') to queue the message.\");\n                }\n                if (options.streamingBehavior === \"followUp\") {\n                    await this._queueFollowUp(expandedText, currentImages);\n                }\n                else {\n                    await this._queueSteer(expandedText, currentImages);\n                }\n                preflightResult?.(true);\n                return;\n            }\n            // Flush any pending bash messages before the new prompt\n            this._flushPendingBashMessages();\n            // Validate model\n            if (!this.model) {\n                throw new Error(formatNoModelSelectedMessage());\n            }\n            const hasConfiguredAuth = this._modelRuntime.hasConfiguredAuth(this.model.provider) ||\n                (await this._modelRuntime.checkAuth(this.model.provider)) !== undefined;\n            if (!hasConfiguredAuth) {\n                const isOAuth = this._modelRuntime.isUsingOAuth(this.model.provider);\n                if (isOAuth) {\n                    throw new Error(`Authentication failed for \"${this.model.provider}\". ` +\n                        `Credentials may have expired or network is unavailable. ` +\n                        `Run '/login ${this.model.provider}' to re-authenticate.`);\n                }\n                throw new Error(formatNoApiKeyFoundMessage(this.model.provider));\n            }\n            // Check if we need to compact before sending (catches aborted responses).\n            // The user's new prompt is sent below, so do not call agent.continue() here.\n            const lastAssistant = this._findLastAssistantMessage();\n            if (lastAssistant) {\n                await this._checkCompaction(lastAssistant, false);\n            }\n            // Build messages array (custom message if any, then user message)\n            messages = [];\n            // Add user message\n            const userContent = [{ type: \"text\", text: expandedText }];\n            if (currentImages) {\n                userContent.push(...currentImages);\n            }\n            messages.push({\n                role: \"user\",\n                content: userContent,\n                timestamp: Date.now(),\n            });\n            // Inject any pending \"nextTurn\" messages as context alongside the user message\n            for (const msg of this._pendingNextTurnMessages) {\n                messages.push(msg);\n            }\n            this._pendingNextTurnMessages = [];\n            // Emit before_agent_start extension event\n            const result = await this._extensionRunner.emitBeforeAgentStart(expandedText, currentImages, this._baseSystemPrompt, this._baseSystemPromptOptions);\n            // Add all custom messages from extensions\n            if (result?.messages) {\n                for (const msg of result.messages) {\n                    messages.push({\n                        role: \"custom\",\n                        customType: msg.customType,\n                        // Untyped extensions can pass null/missing content; normalize at ingestion.\n                        content: msg.content ?? [],\n                        display: msg.display,\n                        details: msg.details,\n                        timestamp: Date.now(),\n                    });\n                }\n            }\n            // Apply extension-modified system prompt, or reset to base\n            if (result?.systemPrompt !== undefined) {\n                this._systemPromptOverride = result.systemPrompt;\n                this.agent.state.systemPrompt = result.systemPrompt;\n            }\n            else {\n                // Ensure we're using the base prompt (in case previous turn had modifications)\n                this._systemPromptOverride = undefined;\n                this.agent.state.systemPrompt = this._baseSystemPrompt;\n            }\n        }\n        catch (error) {\n            preflightResult?.(false);\n            throw error;\n        }\n        if (!messages) {\n            return;\n        }\n        preflightResult?.(true);\n        await this._runAgentPrompt(messages);\n    }\n    /**\n     * Try to execute an extension command. Returns true if command was found and executed.\n     */\n    async _tryExecuteExtensionCommand(text) {\n        // Parse command name and args\n        const spaceIndex = text.indexOf(\" \");\n        const commandName = spaceIndex === -1 ? text.slice(1) : text.slice(1, spaceIndex);\n        const args = spaceIndex === -1 ? \"\" : text.slice(spaceIndex + 1);\n        const command = this._extensionRunner.getCommand(commandName);\n        if (!command)\n            return false;\n        // Get command context from extension runner (includes session control methods)\n        const ctx = this._extensionRunner.createCommandContext();\n        try {\n            await command.handler(args, ctx);\n            return true;\n        }\n        catch (err) {\n            // Emit error via extension runner\n            this._extensionRunner.emitError({\n                extensionPath: `command:${commandName}`,\n                event: \"command\",\n                error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),\n            });\n            return true;\n        }\n    }\n    /**\n     * Expand skill commands (/skill:name args) to their full content.\n     * Returns the expanded text, or the original text if not a skill command or skill not found.\n     * Emits errors via extension runner if file read fails.\n     */\n    _expandSkillCommand(text) {\n        if (!text.startsWith(\"/skill:\"))\n            return text;\n        const spaceIndex = text.indexOf(\" \");\n        const skillName = spaceIndex === -1 ? text.slice(7) : text.slice(7, spaceIndex);\n        const args = spaceIndex === -1 ? \"\" : text.slice(spaceIndex + 1).trim();\n        const skill = this.resourceLoader.getSkills().skills.find((s) => s.name === skillName);\n        if (!skill)\n            return text; // Unknown skill, pass through\n        try {\n            const content = readFileSync(skill.filePath, \"utf-8\");\n            const body = stripFrontmatter(content).trim();\n            const skillBlock = `<skill name=\"${skill.name}\" location=\"${skill.filePath}\">\\nReferences are relative to ${skill.baseDir}.\\n\\n${body}\\n</skill>`;\n            return args ? `${skillBlock}\\n\\n${args}` : skillBlock;\n        }\n        catch (err) {\n            // Emit error like extension commands do\n            this._extensionRunner.emitError({\n                extensionPath: skill.filePath,\n                event: \"skill_expansion\",\n                error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),\n            });\n            return text; // Return original on error\n        }\n    }\n    /**\n     * Queue a steering message while the agent is running.\n     * Delivered after the current assistant turn finishes executing its tool calls,\n     * before the next LLM call.\n     * Expands skill commands and prompt templates. Errors on extension commands.\n     * @param images Optional image attachments to include with the message\n     * @throws Error if text is an extension command\n     */\n    async steer(text, images) {\n        // Check for extension commands (cannot be queued)\n        if (text.startsWith(\"/\")) {\n            this._throwIfExtensionCommand(text);\n        }\n        // Expand skill commands and prompt templates\n        let expandedText = this._expandSkillCommand(text);\n        expandedText = expandPromptTemplate(expandedText, [...this.promptTemplates]);\n        await this._queueSteer(expandedText, images);\n    }\n    /**\n     * Queue a follow-up message to be processed after the agent finishes.\n     * Delivered only when agent has no more tool calls or steering messages.\n     * Expands skill commands and prompt templates. Errors on extension commands.\n     * @param images Optional image attachments to include with the message\n     * @throws Error if text is an extension command\n     */\n    async followUp(text, images) {\n        // Check for extension commands (cannot be queued)\n        if (text.startsWith(\"/\")) {\n            this._throwIfExtensionCommand(text);\n        }\n        // Expand skill commands and prompt templates\n        let expandedText = this._expandSkillCommand(text);\n        expandedText = expandPromptTemplate(expandedText, [...this.promptTemplates]);\n        await this._queueFollowUp(expandedText, images);\n    }\n    /**\n     * Internal: Queue a steering message (already expanded, no extension command check).\n     */\n    async _queueSteer(text, images) {\n        this._steeringMessages.push(text);\n        this._emitQueueUpdate();\n        const content = [{ type: \"text\", text }];\n        if (images) {\n            content.push(...images);\n        }\n        this.agent.steer({\n            role: \"user\",\n            content,\n            timestamp: Date.now(),\n        });\n    }\n    /**\n     * Internal: Queue a follow-up message (already expanded, no extension command check).\n     */\n    async _queueFollowUp(text, images) {\n        this._followUpMessages.push(text);\n        this._emitQueueUpdate();\n        const content = [{ type: \"text\", text }];\n        if (images) {\n            content.push(...images);\n        }\n        this.agent.followUp({\n            role: \"user\",\n            content,\n            timestamp: Date.now(),\n        });\n    }\n    /**\n     * Throw an error if the text is an extension command.\n     */\n    _throwIfExtensionCommand(text) {\n        const spaceIndex = text.indexOf(\" \");\n        const commandName = spaceIndex === -1 ? text.slice(1) : text.slice(1, spaceIndex);\n        const command = this._extensionRunner.getCommand(commandName);\n        if (command) {\n            throw new Error(`Extension command \"/${commandName}\" cannot be queued. Use prompt() or execute the command when not streaming.`);\n        }\n    }\n    /**\n     * Send a custom message to the session. Creates a CustomMessageEntry.\n     *\n     * Handles three cases:\n     * - Streaming: queues message, processed when loop pulls from queue\n     * - Not streaming + triggerTurn: appends to state/session, starts new turn\n     * - Not streaming + no trigger: appends to state/session, no turn\n     *\n     * @param message Custom message with customType, content, display, details\n     * @param options.triggerTurn If true and not streaming, triggers a new LLM turn\n     * @param options.deliverAs Delivery mode: \"steer\", \"followUp\", or \"nextTurn\"\n     */\n    async sendCustomMessage(message, options) {\n        const appMessage = {\n            role: \"custom\",\n            customType: message.customType,\n            // Untyped extensions can pass null/missing content; normalize at ingestion.\n            content: message.content ?? [],\n            display: message.display,\n            details: message.details,\n            timestamp: Date.now(),\n        };\n        if (options?.deliverAs === \"nextTurn\") {\n            this._pendingNextTurnMessages.push(appMessage);\n        }\n        else if (this.isStreaming) {\n            if (options?.deliverAs === \"followUp\") {\n                this.agent.followUp(appMessage);\n            }\n            else {\n                this.agent.steer(appMessage);\n            }\n        }\n        else if (options?.triggerTurn) {\n            await this._runAgentPrompt(appMessage);\n        }\n        else {\n            this.agent.state.messages.push(appMessage);\n            this.sessionManager.appendCustomMessageEntry(message.customType, message.content, message.display, message.details);\n            this._emit({ type: \"message_start\", message: appMessage });\n            this._emit({ type: \"message_end\", message: appMessage });\n        }\n    }\n    /**\n     * Send a user message to the agent. Always triggers a turn.\n     * When the agent is streaming, use deliverAs to specify how to queue the message.\n     *\n     * @param content User message content (string or content array)\n     * @param options.deliverAs Delivery mode when streaming: \"steer\" or \"followUp\"\n     */\n    async sendUserMessage(content, options) {\n        // Normalize content to text string + optional images\n        let text;\n        let images;\n        if (typeof content === \"string\") {\n            text = content;\n        }\n        else {\n            const textParts = [];\n            images = [];\n            for (const part of content) {\n                if (part.type === \"text\") {\n                    textParts.push(part.text);\n                }\n                else {\n                    images.push(part);\n                }\n            }\n            text = textParts.join(\"\\n\");\n            if (images.length === 0)\n                images = undefined;\n        }\n        // Use prompt() with expandPromptTemplates: false to skip command handling and template expansion\n        await this.prompt(text, {\n            expandPromptTemplates: false,\n            streamingBehavior: options?.deliverAs,\n            images,\n            source: \"extension\",\n        });\n    }\n    /**\n     * Clear all queued messages and return them.\n     * Useful for restoring to editor when user aborts.\n     * @returns Object with steering and followUp arrays\n     */\n    clearQueue() {\n        const steering = [...this._steeringMessages];\n        const followUp = [...this._followUpMessages];\n        this._steeringMessages = [];\n        this._followUpMessages = [];\n        this.agent.clearAllQueues();\n        this._emitQueueUpdate();\n        return { steering, followUp };\n    }\n    /** Number of pending messages (includes both steering and follow-up) */\n    get pendingMessageCount() {\n        return this._steeringMessages.length + this._followUpMessages.length;\n    }\n    /** Get pending steering messages (read-only) */\n    getSteeringMessages() {\n        return this._steeringMessages;\n    }\n    /** Get pending follow-up messages (read-only) */\n    getFollowUpMessages() {\n        return this._followUpMessages;\n    }\n    get resourceLoader() {\n        return this._resourceLoader;\n    }\n    /**\n     * Abort current operation and wait for agent to become idle.\n     */\n    async abort() {\n        this.abortRetry();\n        this.agent.abort();\n        await this.waitForIdle();\n    }\n    async waitForIdle() {\n        if (this.isIdle) {\n            return;\n        }\n        await this._getIdleWaitPromise();\n    }\n    // =========================================================================\n    // Model Management\n    // =========================================================================\n    async _emitModelSelect(nextModel, previousModel, source) {\n        if (modelsAreEqual(previousModel, nextModel))\n            return;\n        await this._extensionRunner.emit({\n            type: \"model_select\",\n            model: nextModel,\n            previousModel,\n            source,\n        });\n    }\n    /**\n     * Set model directly.\n     * Validates that auth is configured, saves to session and settings.\n     * @throws Error if no auth is configured for the model\n     */\n    async setModel(model) {\n        if (!(await this._modelRuntime.checkAuth(model.provider))) {\n            throw new Error(`No API key for ${model.provider}/${model.id}`);\n        }\n        const previousModel = this.model;\n        const thinkingLevel = this._getThinkingLevelForModelSwitch();\n        this.agent.state.model = model;\n        this.sessionManager.appendModelChange(model.provider, model.id);\n        this.settingsManager.setDefaultModelAndProvider(model.provider, model.id);\n        // Re-clamp thinking level for new model's capabilities\n        this.setThinkingLevel(thinkingLevel);\n        await this._emitModelSelect(model, previousModel, \"set\");\n    }\n    /**\n     * Cycle to next/previous model.\n     * Uses scoped models (from --models flag) if available, otherwise all available models.\n     * @param direction - \"forward\" (default) or \"backward\"\n     * @returns The new model info, or undefined if only one model available\n     */\n    async cycleModel(direction = \"forward\") {\n        if (this._scopedModels.length > 0) {\n            return this._cycleScopedModel(direction);\n        }\n        return this._cycleAvailableModel(direction);\n    }\n    async _cycleScopedModel(direction) {\n        const availableIds = new Set(this._modelRuntime.getAvailableSnapshot().map((model) => `${model.provider}\\0${model.id}`));\n        const scopedModels = this._scopedModels.filter((scoped) => availableIds.has(`${scoped.model.provider}\\0${scoped.model.id}`));\n        if (scopedModels.length <= 1)\n            return undefined;\n        const currentModel = this.model;\n        let currentIndex = scopedModels.findIndex((sm) => modelsAreEqual(sm.model, currentModel));\n        if (currentIndex === -1)\n            currentIndex = 0;\n        const len = scopedModels.length;\n        const nextIndex = direction === \"forward\" ? (currentIndex + 1) % len : (currentIndex - 1 + len) % len;\n        const next = scopedModels[nextIndex];\n        const thinkingLevel = this._getThinkingLevelForModelSwitch(next.thinkingLevel);\n        // Apply model\n        this.agent.state.model = next.model;\n        this.sessionManager.appendModelChange(next.model.provider, next.model.id);\n        this.settingsManager.setDefaultModelAndProvider(next.model.provider, next.model.id);\n        // Apply thinking level.\n        // - Explicit scoped model thinking level overrides current session level\n        // - Undefined scoped model thinking level inherits the current session preference\n        // setThinkingLevel clamps to model capabilities.\n        this.setThinkingLevel(thinkingLevel);\n        await this._emitModelSelect(next.model, currentModel, \"cycle\");\n        return { model: next.model, thinkingLevel: this.thinkingLevel, isScoped: true };\n    }\n    async _cycleAvailableModel(direction) {\n        const availableModels = this._modelRuntime.getAvailableSnapshot();\n        if (availableModels.length <= 1)\n            return undefined;\n        const currentModel = this.model;\n        let currentIndex = availableModels.findIndex((m) => modelsAreEqual(m, currentModel));\n        if (currentIndex === -1)\n            currentIndex = 0;\n        const len = availableModels.length;\n        const nextIndex = direction === \"forward\" ? (currentIndex + 1) % len : (currentIndex - 1 + len) % len;\n        const nextModel = availableModels[nextIndex];\n        const thinkingLevel = this._getThinkingLevelForModelSwitch();\n        this.agent.state.model = nextModel;\n        this.sessionManager.appendModelChange(nextModel.provider, nextModel.id);\n        this.settingsManager.setDefaultModelAndProvider(nextModel.provider, nextModel.id);\n        // Re-clamp thinking level for new model's capabilities\n        this.setThinkingLevel(thinkingLevel);\n        await this._emitModelSelect(nextModel, currentModel, \"cycle\");\n        return { model: nextModel, thinkingLevel: this.thinkingLevel, isScoped: false };\n    }\n    // =========================================================================\n    // Thinking Level Management\n    // =========================================================================\n    /**\n     * Set thinking level.\n     * Clamps to model capabilities based on available thinking levels.\n     * Saves to session and settings only if the level actually changes.\n     */\n    setThinkingLevel(level) {\n        const availableLevels = this.getAvailableThinkingLevels();\n        const effectiveLevel = availableLevels.includes(level) ? level : this._clampThinkingLevel(level, availableLevels);\n        // Only persist if actually changing\n        const previousLevel = this.agent.state.thinkingLevel;\n        const isChanging = effectiveLevel !== previousLevel;\n        this.agent.state.thinkingLevel = effectiveLevel;\n        if (isChanging) {\n            this.sessionManager.appendThinkingLevelChange(effectiveLevel);\n            if (this.supportsThinking() || effectiveLevel !== \"off\") {\n                this.settingsManager.setDefaultThinkingLevel(effectiveLevel);\n            }\n            this._emit({ type: \"thinking_level_changed\", level: effectiveLevel });\n            void this._extensionRunner.emit({\n                type: \"thinking_level_select\",\n                level: effectiveLevel,\n                previousLevel,\n            });\n        }\n    }\n    /**\n     * Cycle to next thinking level.\n     * @returns New level, or undefined if model doesn't support thinking\n     */\n    cycleThinkingLevel() {\n        if (!this.supportsThinking())\n            return undefined;\n        const levels = this.getAvailableThinkingLevels();\n        const currentIndex = levels.indexOf(this.thinkingLevel);\n        const nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % levels.length;\n        const nextLevel = levels[nextIndex];\n        this.setThinkingLevel(nextLevel);\n        return nextLevel;\n    }\n    /**\n     * Get available thinking levels for current model.\n     * The provider will clamp to what the specific model supports internally.\n     */\n    getAvailableThinkingLevels() {\n        if (!this.model)\n            return THINKING_LEVELS;\n        return getSupportedThinkingLevels(this.model);\n    }\n    /**\n     * Check if current model supports thinking/reasoning.\n     */\n    supportsThinking() {\n        return !!this.model?.reasoning;\n    }\n    _getThinkingLevelForModelSwitch(explicitLevel) {\n        if (explicitLevel !== undefined) {\n            return explicitLevel;\n        }\n        if (!this.supportsThinking()) {\n            return this.settingsManager.getDefaultThinkingLevel() ?? DEFAULT_THINKING_LEVEL;\n        }\n        return this.thinkingLevel;\n    }\n    _clampThinkingLevel(level, _availableLevels) {\n        return this.model ? clampThinkingLevel(this.model, level) : \"off\";\n    }\n    // =========================================================================\n    // Queue Mode Management\n    // =========================================================================\n    syncQueueModesFromSettings() {\n        this.agent.steeringMode = this.settingsManager.getSteeringMode();\n        this.agent.followUpMode = this.settingsManager.getFollowUpMode();\n    }\n    /**\n     * Set steering message mode.\n     * Saves to settings.\n     */\n    setSteeringMode(mode) {\n        this.agent.steeringMode = mode;\n        this.settingsManager.setSteeringMode(mode);\n    }\n    /**\n     * Set follow-up message mode.\n     * Saves to settings.\n     */\n    setFollowUpMode(mode) {\n        this.agent.followUpMode = mode;\n        this.settingsManager.setFollowUpMode(mode);\n    }\n    // =========================================================================\n    // Compaction\n    // =========================================================================\n    /**\n     * Manually compact the session context.\n     * Aborts current agent operation first.\n     * @param customInstructions Optional instructions for the compaction summary\n     */\n    async compact(customInstructions) {\n        await this.abort();\n        this._compactionAbortController = new AbortController();\n        this._emit({ type: \"compaction_start\", reason: \"manual\" });\n        try {\n            if (!this.model) {\n                throw new Error(formatNoModelSelectedMessage());\n            }\n            const { model: requestModel, apiKey, headers, env } = await this._getSummarizationRequestAuth(this.model);\n            const pathEntries = this.sessionManager.getBranch();\n            const settings = this.settingsManager.getCompactionSettings();\n            const preparation = prepareCompaction(pathEntries, settings);\n            if (!preparation) {\n                // Check why we can't compact\n                const lastEntry = pathEntries[pathEntries.length - 1];\n                if (lastEntry?.type === \"compaction\") {\n                    throw new Error(\"Already compacted\");\n                }\n                throw new Error(\"Nothing to compact (session too small)\");\n            }\n            let extensionCompaction;\n            let fromExtension = false;\n            if (this._extensionRunner.hasHandlers(\"session_before_compact\")) {\n                const result = (await this._extensionRunner.emit({\n                    type: \"session_before_compact\",\n                    preparation,\n                    branchEntries: pathEntries,\n                    customInstructions,\n                    reason: \"manual\",\n                    willRetry: false,\n                    signal: this._compactionAbortController.signal,\n                }));\n                if (result?.cancel) {\n                    throw new Error(\"Compaction cancelled\");\n                }\n                if (result?.compaction) {\n                    extensionCompaction = result.compaction;\n                    fromExtension = true;\n                }\n            }\n            let summary;\n            let firstKeptEntryId;\n            let tokensBefore;\n            let usage;\n            let details;\n            if (extensionCompaction) {\n                // Extension provided compaction content\n                summary = extensionCompaction.summary;\n                firstKeptEntryId = extensionCompaction.firstKeptEntryId;\n                tokensBefore = extensionCompaction.tokensBefore;\n                usage = extensionCompaction.usage;\n                details = extensionCompaction.details;\n            }\n            else {\n                // Generate compaction result\n                const result = await compact(preparation, requestModel, apiKey, headers, customInstructions, this._compactionAbortController.signal, this.thinkingLevel, this.agent.streamFunction, env, this.settingsManager.getRetrySettings(), this._summarizationRetryCallbacks({ source: \"compaction\", reason: \"manual\" }));\n                summary = result.summary;\n                firstKeptEntryId = result.firstKeptEntryId;\n                tokensBefore = result.tokensBefore;\n                usage = result.usage;\n                details = result.details;\n            }\n            if (this._compactionAbortController.signal.aborted) {\n                throw new Error(\"Compaction cancelled\");\n            }\n            this.sessionManager.appendCompaction(summary, firstKeptEntryId, tokensBefore, details, fromExtension, usage);\n            const newEntries = this.sessionManager.getEntries();\n            const sessionContext = this.sessionManager.buildSessionContext();\n            this.agent.state.messages = sessionContext.messages;\n            const estimatedTokensAfter = estimateMessagesTokens(sessionContext.messages);\n            // Get the saved compaction entry for the extension event\n            const savedCompactionEntry = newEntries.find((e) => e.type === \"compaction\" && e.summary === summary);\n            if (this._extensionRunner && savedCompactionEntry) {\n                await this._extensionRunner.emit({\n                    type: \"session_compact\",\n                    compactionEntry: savedCompactionEntry,\n                    fromExtension,\n                    reason: \"manual\",\n                    willRetry: false,\n                });\n            }\n            const compactionResult = {\n                summary,\n                firstKeptEntryId,\n                tokensBefore,\n                estimatedTokensAfter,\n                usage,\n                details,\n            };\n            // compaction_end listeners may submit queued prompts, so expose idle state before notifying them.\n            this._compactionAbortController = undefined;\n            this._emit({\n                type: \"compaction_end\",\n                reason: \"manual\",\n                result: compactionResult,\n                aborted: false,\n                willRetry: false,\n            });\n            return compactionResult;\n        }\n        catch (error) {\n            const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\n            const aborted = message === \"Compaction cancelled\" || (error instanceof Error && error.name === \"AbortError\");\n            this._compactionAbortController = undefined;\n            this._emit({\n                type: \"compaction_end\",\n                reason: \"manual\",\n                result: undefined,\n                aborted,\n                willRetry: false,\n                errorMessage: aborted ? undefined : `Compaction failed: ${message}`,\n            });\n            throw error;\n        }\n        finally {\n            this._compactionAbortController = undefined;\n        }\n    }\n    /**\n     * Cancel in-progress compaction (manual or auto).\n     */\n    abortCompaction() {\n        this._compactionAbortController?.abort();\n        this._autoCompactionAbortController?.abort();\n    }\n    /**\n     * Cancel in-progress branch summarization.\n     */\n    abortBranchSummary() {\n        this._branchSummaryAbortController?.abort();\n    }\n    /**\n     * Check if compaction is needed and run it.\n     * Called after agent_end and before prompt submission.\n     *\n     * Two cases:\n     * 1. Recoverable failure: LLM returned context overflow or stopped below its desired output limit;\n     *    remove the assistant message, compact, and auto-retry once\n     * 2. Threshold: Context over threshold, compact, NO auto-retry (user continues manually)\n     *\n     * @param assistantMessage The assistant message to check\n     * @param skipAbortedCheck If false, include aborted messages (for pre-prompt check). Default: true\n     */\n    async _checkCompaction(assistantMessage, skipAbortedCheck = true) {\n        const settings = this.settingsManager.getCompactionSettings();\n        if (!settings.enabled)\n            return false;\n        // Skip if message was aborted (user cancelled) - unless skipAbortedCheck is false\n        if (skipAbortedCheck && assistantMessage.stopReason === \"aborted\")\n            return false;\n        const contextWindow = this.model?.contextWindow ?? 0;\n        // Skip overflow check if the message came from a different model.\n        // This handles the case where user switched from a smaller-context model (e.g. opus)\n        // to a larger-context model (e.g. codex) - the overflow error from the old model\n        // shouldn't trigger compaction for the new model.\n        const sameModel = this.model && assistantMessage.provider === this.model.provider && assistantMessage.model === this.model.id;\n        // Skip compaction checks if this assistant message is older than the latest\n        // compaction boundary. This prevents a stale pre-compaction usage/error\n        // from retriggering compaction on the first prompt after compaction.\n        const compactionEntry = getLatestCompactionEntry(this.sessionManager.getBranch());\n        const assistantIsFromBeforeCompaction = compactionEntry !== null && assistantMessage.timestamp <= new Date(compactionEntry.timestamp).getTime();\n        if (assistantIsFromBeforeCompaction) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        // Case 1: Recoverable failure. Explicit/silent context overflow still uses context metadata.\n        // A length stop is recoverable when output ended below the model's original desired limit,\n        // independent of the configured context size or any context-clamped provider request limit.\n        // A successful response over the configured window should compact but must not retry: the\n        // assistant answer already completed and agent.continue() cannot continue from an assistant.\n        const recoverableLength = sameModel && isRecoverableLength(assistantMessage, this.model?.maxTokens ?? 0);\n        if (sameModel && (isContextOverflow(assistantMessage, contextWindow) || recoverableLength)) {\n            const willRetry = assistantMessage.stopReason !== \"stop\";\n            if (!willRetry) {\n                return await this._runAutoCompaction(\"overflow\", false);\n            }\n            if (this._overflowRecoveryAttempted) {\n                this._emit({\n                    type: \"compaction_end\",\n                    reason: \"overflow\",\n                    result: undefined,\n                    aborted: false,\n                    willRetry: false,\n                    errorMessage: \"Context overflow recovery failed after one compact-and-retry attempt. Try reducing context or switching to a larger-context model.\",\n                });\n                return false;\n            }\n            this._overflowRecoveryAttempted = true;\n            // Remove the failed or truncated message from agent state. It remains in session history,\n            // but must not be included in the compact-and-retry context.\n            const messages = this.agent.state.messages;\n            if (messages.length > 0 && messages[messages.length - 1].role === \"assistant\") {\n                this.agent.state.messages = messages.slice(0, -1);\n            }\n            return await this._runAutoCompaction(\"overflow\", willRetry);\n        }\n        // Case 2: Threshold - context is getting large\n        // For error messages or all-zero usage messages, estimate from the last valid response.\n        // This ensures sessions that hit persistent API errors (e.g. 529) or malformed zero-usage\n        // responses can still compact and do not reset context accounting.\n        let contextTokens;\n        const directContextTokens = assistantMessage.usage ? calculateContextTokens(assistantMessage.usage) : 0;\n        if (assistantMessage.stopReason === \"error\" || directContextTokens === 0) {\n            const messages = this.agent.state.messages;\n            const estimate = estimateContextTokens(messages);\n            if (estimate.lastUsageIndex === null)\n                return false; // No usage data at all\n            // Verify the usage source is post-compaction. Kept pre-compaction messages\n            // have stale usage reflecting the old (larger) context and would falsely\n            // trigger compaction right after one just finished.\n            const usageMsg = messages[estimate.lastUsageIndex];\n            if (compactionEntry &&\n                usageMsg.role === \"assistant\" &&\n                usageMsg.timestamp <= new
