Date(compactionEntry.timestamp).getTime()) {\n                return false;\n            }\n            contextTokens = estimate.tokens;\n        }\n        else {\n            contextTokens = directContextTokens;\n        }\n        if (shouldCompact(contextTokens, contextWindow, settings)) {\n            return await this._runAutoCompaction(\"threshold\", false);\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n    /**\n     * Internal: Run auto-compaction with events.\n     */\n    async _runAutoCompaction(reason, willRetry) {\n        const settings = this.settingsManager.getCompactionSettings();\n        let started = false;\n        try {\n            if (!this.model) {\n                return false;\n            }\n            const { model: requestModel, apiKey, headers, env } = await this._getSummarizationRequestAuth(this.model);\n            const pathEntries = this.sessionManager.getBranch();\n            const preparation = prepareCompaction(pathEntries, settings);\n            if (!preparation) {\n                return false;\n            }\n            this._emit({ type: \"compaction_start\", reason });\n            this._autoCompactionAbortController = new AbortController();\n            started = true;\n            let extensionCompaction;\n            let fromExtension = false;\n            if (this._extensionRunner.hasHandlers(\"session_before_compact\")) {\n                const extensionResult = (await this._extensionRunner.emit({\n                    type: \"session_before_compact\",\n                    preparation,\n                    branchEntries: pathEntries,\n                    customInstructions: undefined,\n                    reason,\n                    willRetry,\n                    signal: this._autoCompactionAbortController.signal,\n                }));\n                if (extensionResult?.cancel) {\n                    this._emit({\n                        type: \"compaction_end\",\n                        reason,\n                        result: undefined,\n                        aborted: true,\n                        willRetry: false,\n                    });\n                    return false;\n                }\n                if (extensionResult?.compaction) {\n                    extensionCompaction = extensionResult.compaction;\n                    fromExtension = true;\n                }\n            }\n            let summary;\n            let firstKeptEntryId;\n            let tokensBefore;\n            let usage;\n            let details;\n            if (extensionCompaction) {\n                // Extension provided compaction content\n                summary = extensionCompaction.summary;\n                firstKeptEntryId = extensionCompaction.firstKeptEntryId;\n                tokensBefore = extensionCompaction.tokensBefore;\n                usage = extensionCompaction.usage;\n                details = extensionCompaction.details;\n            }\n            else {\n                // Generate compaction result\n                const compactResult = await compact(preparation, requestModel, apiKey, headers, undefined, this._autoCompactionAbortController.signal, this.thinkingLevel, this.agent.streamFunction, env, this.settingsManager.getRetrySettings(), this._summarizationRetryCallbacks({ source: \"compaction\", reason }));\n                summary = compactResult.summary;\n                firstKeptEntryId = compactResult.firstKeptEntryId;\n                tokensBefore = compactResult.tokensBefore;\n                usage = compactResult.usage;\n                details = compactResult.details;\n            }\n            if (this._autoCompactionAbortController.signal.aborted) {\n                this._emit({\n                    type: \"compaction_end\",\n                    reason,\n                    result: undefined,\n                    aborted: true,\n                    willRetry: false,\n                });\n                return false;\n            }\n            this.sessionManager.appendCompaction(summary, firstKeptEntryId, tokensBefore, details, fromExtension, usage);\n            const newEntries = this.sessionManager.getEntries();\n            const sessionContext = this.sessionManager.buildSessionContext();\n            this.agent.state.messages = sessionContext.messages;\n            const estimatedTokensAfter = estimateMessagesTokens(sessionContext.messages);\n            // Get the saved compaction entry for the extension event\n            const savedCompactionEntry = newEntries.find((e) => e.type === \"compaction\" && e.summary === summary);\n            if (this._extensionRunner && savedCompactionEntry) {\n                await this._extensionRunner.emit({\n                    type: \"session_compact\",\n                    compactionEntry: savedCompactionEntry,\n                    fromExtension,\n                    reason,\n                    willRetry,\n                });\n            }\n            const result = {\n                summary,\n                firstKeptEntryId,\n                tokensBefore,\n                estimatedTokensAfter,\n                usage,\n                details,\n            };\n            this._emit({ type: \"compaction_end\", reason, result, aborted: false, willRetry });\n            if (willRetry) {\n                const messages = this.agent.state.messages;\n                const lastMsg = messages[messages.length - 1];\n                // The overflow response was persisted on message_end before _checkCompaction() removed it\n                // from agent state. Rebuilding state from the new compaction can restore that kept entry,\n                // leaving an assistant as the final message. agent.continue() rejects that state, so remove\n                // the retriable error or truncated-length response again before continuing the interrupted turn.\n                if (lastMsg?.role === \"assistant\" && (lastMsg.stopReason === \"error\" || lastMsg.stopReason === \"length\")) {\n                    this.agent.state.messages = messages.slice(0, -1);\n                }\n                return true;\n            }\n            // Auto-compaction can complete while follow-up/steering/custom messages are waiting.\n            // Continue once so queued messages are delivered.\n            return this.agent.hasQueuedMessages();\n        }\n        catch (error) {\n            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"compaction failed\";\n            if (started) {\n                this._emit({\n                    type: \"compaction_end\",\n                    reason,\n                    result: undefined,\n                    aborted: false,\n                    willRetry: false,\n                    errorMessage: reason === \"overflow\"\n                        ? `Context overflow recovery failed: ${errorMessage}`\n                        : `Auto-compaction failed: ${errorMessage}`,\n                });\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n        finally {\n            this._autoCompactionAbortController = undefined;\n        }\n    }\n    /**\n     * Toggle auto-compaction setting.\n     */\n    setAutoCompactionEnabled(enabled) {\n        this.settingsManager.setCompactionEnabled(enabled);\n    }\n    /** Whether auto-compaction is enabled */\n    get autoCompactionEnabled() {\n        return this.settingsManager.getCompactionEnabled();\n    }\n    async bindExtensions(bindings) {\n        if (bindings.uiContext !== undefined) {\n            this._extensionUIContext = bindings.uiContext;\n        }\n        if (bindings.mode !== undefined) {\n            this._extensionMode = bindings.mode;\n        }\n        if (bindings.commandContextActions !== undefined) {\n            this._extensionCommandContextActions = bindings.commandContextActions;\n        }\n        if (bindings.abortHandler !== undefined) {\n            this._extensionAbortHandler = bindings.abortHandler;\n        }\n        if (bindings.shutdownHandler !== undefined) {\n            this._extensionShutdownHandler = bindings.shutdownHandler;\n        }\n        if (bindings.onError !== undefined) {\n            this._extensionErrorListener = bindings.onError;\n        }\n        this._applyExtensionBindings(this._extensionRunner);\n        await this._extensionRunner.emit(this._sessionStartEvent);\n        await this.extendResourcesFromExtensions(this._sessionStartEvent.reason === \"reload\" ? \"reload\" : \"startup\");\n    }\n    async extendResourcesFromExtensions(reason) {\n        if (!this._extensionRunner.hasHandlers(\"resources_discover\")) {\n            return;\n        }\n        const { skillPaths, promptPaths, themePaths } = await this._extensionRunner.emitResourcesDiscover(this._cwd, reason);\n        if (skillPaths.length === 0 && promptPaths.length === 0 && themePaths.length === 0) {\n            return;\n        }\n        const extensionPaths = {\n            skillPaths: this.buildExtensionResourcePaths(skillPaths),\n            promptPaths: this.buildExtensionResourcePaths(promptPaths),\n            themePaths: this.buildExtensionResourcePaths(themePaths),\n        };\n        this._resourceLoader.extendResources(extensionPaths);\n        this._baseSystemPrompt = this._rebuildSystemPrompt(this.getActiveToolNames());\n        this.agent.state.systemPrompt = this._baseSystemPrompt;\n    }\n    buildExtensionResourcePaths(entries) {\n        return entries.map((entry) => {\n            const source = this.getExtensionSourceLabel(entry.extensionPath);\n            const baseDir = entry.extensionPath.startsWith(\"<\") ? undefined : dirname(entry.extensionPath);\n            return {\n                path: entry.path,\n                metadata: {\n                    source,\n                    scope: \"temporary\",\n                    origin: \"top-level\",\n                    baseDir,\n                },\n            };\n        });\n    }\n    getExtensionSourceLabel(extensionPath) {\n        if (extensionPath.startsWith(\"<\")) {\n            return `extension:${extensionPath.replace(/[<>]/g, \"\")}`;\n        }\n        const base = basename(extensionPath);\n        const name = base.replace(/\\.(ts|js)$/, \"\");\n        return `extension:${name}`;\n    }\n    _applyExtensionBindings(runner) {\n        runner.setUIContext(this._extensionUIContext, this._extensionMode);\n        runner.bindCommandContext(this._extensionCommandContextActions);\n        this._extensionErrorUnsubscriber?.();\n        this._extensionErrorUnsubscriber = this._extensionErrorListener\n            ? runner.onError(this._extensionErrorListener)\n            : undefined;\n    }\n    _refreshCurrentModelFromRegistry() {\n        const currentModel = this.model;\n        if (!currentModel) {\n            return;\n        }\n        const refreshedModel = this._modelRuntime.getModel(currentModel.provider, currentModel.id);\n        if (!refreshedModel || refreshedModel === currentModel) {\n            return;\n        }\n        this.agent.state.model = refreshedModel;\n    }\n    _bindExtensionCore(runner) {\n        const getCommands = () => {\n            const extensionCommands = runner.getRegisteredCommands().map((command) => ({\n                name: command.invocationName,\n                description: command.description,\n                source: \"extension\",\n                sourceInfo: command.sourceInfo,\n            }));\n            const templates = this.promptTemplates.map((template) => ({\n                name: template.name,\n                description: template.description,\n                source: \"prompt\",\n                sourceInfo: template.sourceInfo,\n            }));\n            const skills = this._resourceLoader.getSkills().skills.map((skill) => ({\n                name: `skill:${skill.name}`,\n                description: skill.description,\n                source: \"skill\",\n                sourceInfo: skill.sourceInfo,\n            }));\n            return [...extensionCommands, ...templates, ...skills];\n        };\n        runner.bindCore({\n            sendMessage: (message, options) => {\n                this.sendCustomMessage(message, options).catch((err) => {\n                    runner.emitError({\n                        extensionPath: \"<runtime>\",\n                        event: \"send_message\",\n                        error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),\n                    });\n                });\n            },\n            sendUserMessage: (content, options) => {\n                this.sendUserMessage(content, options).catch((err) => {\n                    runner.emitError({\n                        extensionPath: \"<runtime>\",\n                        event: \"send_user_message\",\n                        error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err),\n                    });\n                });\n            },\n            appendEntry: (customType, data) => {\n                const entryId = this.sessionManager.appendCustomEntry(customType, data);\n                const entry = this.sessionManager.getEntry(entryId);\n                if (entry) {\n                    this._emit({ type: \"entry_appended\", entry });\n                }\n            },\n            setSessionName: (name) => {\n                this.setSessionName(name);\n            },\n            getSessionName: () => {\n                return this.sessionManager.getSessionName();\n            },\n            setLabel: (entryId, label) => {\n                this.sessionManager.appendLabelChange(entryId, label);\n            },\n            getActiveTools: () => this.getActiveToolNames(),\n            getAllTools: () => this.getAllTools(),\n            setActiveTools: (toolNames) => this.setActiveToolsByName(toolNames),\n            refreshTools: () => this._refreshToolRegistry(),\n            getCommands,\n            setModel: async (model) => {\n                if (!this._modelRuntime.hasConfiguredAuth(model.provider))\n                    return false;\n                await this.setModel(model);\n                return true;\n            },\n            getThinkingLevel: () => this.thinkingLevel,\n            setThinkingLevel: (level) => this.setThinkingLevel(level),\n        }, {\n            getModel: () => this.model,\n            getScopedModels: () => this._scopedModels,\n            isIdle: () => this.isIdle,\n            isProjectTrusted: () => this.settingsManager.isProjectTrusted(),\n            getSignal: () => this.agent.signal,\n            abort: () => {\n                if (this._extensionAbortHandler) {\n                    this._extensionAbortHandler();\n                    return;\n                }\n                void this.abort();\n            },\n            hasPendingMessages: () => this.pendingMessageCount > 0,\n            shutdown: () => {\n                this._extensionShutdownHandler?.();\n            },\n            getContextUsage: () => this.getContextUsage(),\n            compact: (options) => {\n                void (async () => {\n                    try {\n                        const result = await this.compact(options?.customInstructions);\n                        options?.onComplete?.(result);\n                    }\n                    catch (error) {\n                        const err = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));\n                        options?.onError?.(err);\n                    }\n                })();\n            },\n            getSystemPrompt: () => this.systemPrompt,\n            getSystemPromptOptions: () => this._baseSystemPromptOptions,\n        }, {\n            registerProvider: (name, config) => {\n                this._modelRuntime.registerProvider(name, config);\n                this._refreshCurrentModelFromRegistry();\n            },\n            registerNativeProvider: (provider) => {\n                this._modelRuntime.registerNativeProvider(provider);\n                this._refreshCurrentModelFromRegistry();\n            },\n            unregisterProvider: (name) => {\n                this._modelRuntime.unregisterProvider(name);\n                this._refreshCurrentModelFromRegistry();\n            },\n        });\n    }\n    _refreshToolRegistry(options) {\n        const previousRegistryNames = new Set(this._toolRegistry.keys());\n        const previousActiveToolNames = this.getActiveToolNames();\n        const allowedToolNames = this._allowedToolNames;\n        const excludedToolNames = this._excludedToolNames;\n        const isAllowedTool = (name) => (!allowedToolNames || allowedToolNames.has(name)) && !excludedToolNames?.has(name);\n        const registeredTools = this._extensionRunner.getAllRegisteredTools();\n        const allCustomTools = [\n            ...registeredTools,\n            ...this._customTools.map((definition) => ({\n                definition,\n                sourceInfo: createSyntheticSourceInfo(`<sdk:${definition.name}>`, { source: \"sdk\" }),\n            })),\n        ].filter((tool) => isAllowedTool(tool.definition.name));\n        const definitionRegistry = new Map(Array.from(this._baseToolDefinitions.entries())\n            .filter(([name]) => isAllowedTool(name))\n            .map(([name, definition]) => [\n            name,\n            {\n                definition,\n                sourceInfo: createSyntheticSourceInfo(`<builtin:${name}>`, { source: \"builtin\" }),\n            },\n        ]));\n        for (const tool of allCustomTools) {\n            definitionRegistry.set(tool.definition.name, {\n                definition: tool.definition,\n                sourceInfo: tool.sourceInfo,\n            });\n        }\n        this._toolDefinitions = definitionRegistry;\n        this._toolPromptSnippets = new Map(Array.from(definitionRegistry.values())\n            .map(({ definition }) => {\n            const snippet = this._normalizePromptSnippet(definition.promptSnippet);\n            return snippet ? [definition.name, snippet] : undefined;\n        })\n            .filter((entry) => entry !== undefined));\n        this._toolPromptGuidelines = new Map(Array.from(definitionRegistry.values())\n            .map(({ definition }) => {\n            const guidelines = this._normalizePromptGuidelines(definition.promptGuidelines);\n            return guidelines.length > 0 ? [definition.name, guidelines] : undefined;\n        })\n            .filter((entry) => entry !== undefined));\n        const runner = this._extensionRunner;\n        const wrappedExtensionTools = wrapRegisteredTools(allCustomTools, runner);\n        const wrappedBuiltInTools = wrapRegisteredTools(Array.from(this._baseToolDefinitions.values())\n            .filter((definition) => isAllowedTool(definition.name))\n            .map((definition) => ({\n            definition,\n            sourceInfo: createSyntheticSourceInfo(`<builtin:${definition.name}>`, { source: \"builtin\" }),\n        })), runner);\n        const toolRegistry = new Map(wrappedBuiltInTools.map((tool) => [tool.name, tool]));\n        for (const tool of wrappedExtensionTools) {\n            toolRegistry.set(tool.name, tool);\n        }\n        this._toolRegistry = toolRegistry;\n        const nextActiveToolNames = (options?.activeToolNames ? [...options.activeToolNames] : [...previousActiveToolNames]).filter((name) => isAllowedTool(name));\n        if (allowedToolNames) {\n            for (const toolName of this._toolRegistry.keys()) {\n                if (allowedToolNames.has(toolName)) {\n                    nextActiveToolNames.push(toolName);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        else if (options?.includeAllExtensionTools) {\n            for (const tool of wrappedExtensionTools) {\n                nextActiveToolNames.push(tool.name);\n            }\n        }\n        else if (!options?.activeToolNames) {\n            for (const toolName of this._toolRegistry.keys()) {\n                if (!previousRegistryNames.has(toolName)) {\n                    nextActiveToolNames.push(toolName);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        this.setActiveToolsByName([...new Set(nextActiveToolNames)]);\n    }\n    _buildRuntime(options) {\n        const autoResizeImages = this.settingsManager.getImageAutoResize();\n        const shellCommandPrefix = this.settingsManager.getShellCommandPrefix();\n        const shellPath = this.settingsManager.getShellPath();\n        const baseToolDefinitions = this._baseToolsOverride\n            ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(this._baseToolsOverride).map(([name, tool]) => [\n                name,\n                createToolDefinitionFromAgentTool(tool),\n            ]))\n            : createAllToolDefinitions(this._cwd, {\n                read: { autoResizeImages },\n                bash: { commandPrefix: shellCommandPrefix, shellPath },\n            });\n        this._baseToolDefinitions = new Map(Object.entries(baseToolDefinitions).map(([name, tool]) => [name, tool]));\n        const extensionsResult = this._resourceLoader.getExtensions();\n        if (options.flagValues) {\n            for (const [name, value] of options.flagValues) {\n                extensionsResult.runtime.flagValues.set(name, value);\n            }\n        }\n        this._extensionRunner = new ExtensionRunner(extensionsResult.extensions, extensionsResult.runtime, this._cwd, this.sessionManager, new ModelRegistry(this._modelRuntime));\n        if (this._extensionRunnerRef) {\n            this._extensionRunnerRef.current = this._extensionRunner;\n        }\n        this._bindExtensionCore(this._extensionRunner);\n        this._applyExtensionBindings(this._extensionRunner);\n        const defaultActiveToolNames = this._baseToolsOverride\n            ? Object.keys(this._baseToolsOverride)\n            : [\"read\", \"bash\", \"edit\", \"write\"];\n        const baseActiveToolNames = options.activeToolNames ?? defaultActiveToolNames;\n        this._refreshToolRegistry({\n            activeToolNames: baseActiveToolNames,\n            includeAllExtensionTools: options.includeAllExtensionTools,\n        });\n    }\n    async reload(options) {\n        const oldRunner = this._extensionRunner;\n        const previousFlagValues = oldRunner.getFlagValues();\n        await emitSessionShutdownEvent(oldRunner, { type: \"session_shutdown\", reason: \"reload\" });\n        oldRunner.invalidate();\n        await this.settingsManager.reload();\n        this.syncQueueModesFromSettings();\n        resetApiProviders();\n        await this._resourceLoader.reload();\n        this._buildRuntime({\n            activeToolNames: this.getActiveToolNames(),\n            flagValues: previousFlagValues,\n            includeAllExtensionTools: true,\n        });\n        const hasBindings = this._extensionUIContext ||\n            this._extensionCommandContextActions ||\n            this._extensionShutdownHandler ||\n            this._extensionErrorListener;\n        if (hasBindings) {\n            await options?.beforeSessionStart?.();\n            await this._extensionRunner.emit({ type: \"session_start\", reason: \"reload\" });\n            await this.extendResourcesFromExtensions(\"reload\");\n        }\n    }\n    // =========================================================================\n    // Auto-Retry\n    // =========================================================================\n    /**\n     * Check if an error is retryable (overloaded, rate limit, server errors).\n     * Context overflow errors are NOT retryable (handled by compaction instead).\n     */\n    _isRetryableError(message) {\n        // Context overflow is handled by compaction, not retry.\n        if (isContextOverflow(message, this.model?.contextWindow ?? 0))\n            return false;\n        return isRetryableAssistantError(message);\n    }\n    /**\n     * Retry policy + callbacks shared by compaction and branch-summary summarization calls.\n     * Uses the same `settings.retry` budget/backoff as agent-turn retries so a single transient\n     * stream drop no longer fails the whole operation. `source` carries the context\n     * the TUI needs to render the retry and recreate the underlying indicator.\n     */\n    _summarizationRetryCallbacks(source) {\n        return {\n            onRetryScheduled: (attempt, maxAttempts, delayMs, errorMessage) => {\n                this._emit({\n                    type: \"summarization_retry_scheduled\",\n                    attempt,\n                    maxAttempts,\n                    delayMs,\n                    errorMessage,\n                });\n            },\n            onRetryAttemptStart: () => {\n                this._emit({\n                    type: \"summarization_retry_attempt_start\",\n                    ...source,\n                });\n            },\n            onRetryFinished: () => {\n                this._emit({ type: \"summarization_retry_finished\" });\n            },\n        };\n    }\n    /**\n     * Prepare a retryable error for continuation with exponential backoff.\n     * @returns true if the caller should continue the agent, false otherwise\n     */\n    async _prepareRetry(message) {\n        const settings = this.settingsManager.getRetrySettings();\n        if (!settings.enabled) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        this._retryAttempt++;\n        if (this._retryAttempt > settings.maxRetries) {\n            // Preserve the completed attempt count so post-run handling can emit the final failure.\n            this._retryAttempt--;\n            return false;\n        }\n        const delayMs = settings.baseDelayMs * 2 ** (this._retryAttempt - 1);\n        this._emit({\n            type: \"auto_retry_start\",\n            attempt: this._retryAttempt,\n            maxAttempts: settings.maxRetries,\n            delayMs,\n            errorMessage: message.errorMessage || \"Unknown error\",\n        });\n        // Remove error message from agent state (keep in session for history)\n        const messages = this.agent.state.messages;\n        if (messages.length > 0 && messages[messages.length - 1].role === \"assistant\") {\n            this.agent.state.messages = messages.slice(0, -1);\n        }\n        // Wait with exponential backoff (abortable)\n        this._retryAbortController = new AbortController();\n        try {\n            await sleep(delayMs, this._retryAbortController.signal);\n        }\n        catch {\n            // Aborted during sleep - emit end event so UI can clean up\n            const attempt = this._retryAttempt;\n            this._retryAttempt = 0;\n            this._emit({\n                type: \"auto_retry_end\",\n                success: false,\n                attempt,\n                finalError: \"Retry cancelled\",\n            });\n            return false;\n        }\n        finally {\n            this._retryAbortController = undefined;\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n    /**\n     * Cancel in-progress retry.\n     */\n    abortRetry() {\n        this._retryAbortController?.abort();\n    }\n    /** Whether auto-retry is currently in progress */\n    get isRetrying() {\n        return this._retryAbortController !== undefined;\n    }\n    /** Whether auto-retry is enabled */\n    get autoRetryEnabled() {\n        return this.settingsManager.getRetryEnabled();\n    }\n    /**\n     * Toggle auto-retry setting.\n     */\n    setAutoRetryEnabled(enabled) {\n        this.settingsManager.setRetryEnabled(enabled);\n    }\n    // =========================================================================\n    // Bash Execution\n    // =========================================================================\n    /**\n     * Execute a bash command.\n     * Adds result to agent context and session.\n     * @param command The bash command to execute\n     * @param onChunk Optional streaming callback for output\n     * @param options.excludeFromContext If true, command output won't be sent to LLM (!! prefix)\n     * @param options.id Optional identifier included in bash execution update events\n     * @param options.operations Custom BashOperations for remote execution\n     */\n    async executeBash(command, onChunk, options) {\n        const abortController = new AbortController();\n        this._bashAbortControllers.add(abortController);\n        // Apply command prefix if configured (e.g., \"shopt -s expand_aliases\" for alias support)\n        const prefix = this.settingsManager.getShellCommandPrefix();\n        const shellPath = this.settingsManager.getShellPath();\n        const resolvedCommand = prefix ? `${prefix}\\n${command}` : command;\n        try {\n            const result = await executeBashWithOperations(resolvedCommand, this.sessionManager.getCwd(), options?.operations ?? createLocalBashOperations({ shellPath }), {\n                onChunk: (delta) => {\n                    onChunk?.(delta);\n                    this._emit({ type: \"bash_execution_update\", id: options?.id, delta });\n                },\n                signal: abortController.signal,\n            });\n            this.recordBashResult(command, result, options);\n            return result;\n        }\n        finally {\n            this._bashAbortControllers.delete(abortController);\n        }\n    }\n    /**\n     * Record a bash execution result in session history.\n     * Used by executeBash and by extensions that handle bash execution themselves.\n     */\n    recordBashResult(command, result, options) {\n        const bashMessage = {\n            role: \"bashExecution\",\n            command,\n            output: result.output,\n            exitCode: result.exitCode,\n            cancelled: result.cancelled,\n            truncated: result.truncated,\n            fullOutputPath: result.fullOutputPath,\n            timestamp: Date.now(),\n            excludeFromContext: options?.excludeFromContext,\n        };\n        // If agent is streaming, defer adding to avoid breaking tool_use/tool_result ordering\n        if (this.isStreaming) {\n            // Queue for later - will be flushed on agent_end\n            this._pendingBashMessages.push(bashMessage);\n        }\n        else {\n            // Add to agent state immediately\n            this.agent.state.messages.push(bashMessage);\n            // Save to session\n            this.sessionManager.appendMessage(bashMessage);\n        }\n    }\n    /**\n     * Cancel running bash command.\n     */\n    abortBash() {\n        for (const abortController of [...this._bashAbortControllers]) {\n            abortController.abort();\n        }\n    }\n    /** Whether a bash command is currently running */\n    get isBashRunning() {\n        return this._bashAbortControllers.size > 0;\n    }\n    /** Whether there are pending bash messages waiting to be flushed */\n    get hasPendingBashMessages() {\n        return   */\n    _flushPendingBashMessages() {\n        if (this._pendingBashMessages.length === 0)\n            return;\n        for (const bashMessage of this._pendingBashMessages) {\n            // Add to =========================================================================\n    /**\n     * Navigate to a different node in the session tree.\n     * Unlike fork() which creates a new session file, (this.isStreaming) {\n            throw new Error(\"Wait for the current response to finish before navigating the session tree.\");\n        }\n        const oldLeafId = this.sessionManager.getLeafId();\n        // No-op if already at target\n        if (targetId === oldLeafId) {\n            return { cancelled: false };\n        }\n        // Model required for     customInstructions,\n            replaceInstructions,\n            label,\n        };\n        // Set up abort controller for summarization\n        this._branchSummaryAbortController = new AbortController();\n        try {\n            let extensionSummary;\n            let fromExtension = false;\n            // Emit session_before_tree event\n            if               }\n                if (result?.summary && options.summarize) {\n                    extensionSummary = result.summary;\n                    fromExtension = true;\n                }\n                // Allow extensions to override instructions and label\n                if (result?.customInstructions !== undefined) {\n                    customInstructions = result.customInstructions;\n                }\n                if (result?.replaceInstructions !== undefined) {\n                    replaceInstructions = result.replaceInstructions;\n                }\n                if (result?.label !== undefined) {\n                    label = result.label;\n                }\n            }\n            // Run default summarizer if needed\n            let summaryText;\n            let summaryDetails;\n            let summaryUsage;\n            if (options.summarize && entriesToSummarize.length > 0 && !extensionSummary) {\n                const model = this.model;\n                const { model: requestModel, apiKey, headers, env } = await this._getSummarizationRequestAuth(model);\n                const branchSummarySettings = replaceInstructions,\n                    reserveTokens: branchSummarySettings.reserveTokens,\n                    streamFn: this.agent.streamFunction,\n                    retry:                    return { cancelled: true, aborted: true };\n                }\n                if (result.error) {\n                    throw new Error(result.error);\n                }\n getSessionStats() {\n        let userMessages = 0;\n        let assistantMessages = 0;\n        let toolResults = 0;\n        let totalMessages = 0;\n        let toolCalls = 0;\n        const assistantMsg.content.filter((c) => c.type === \"toolCall\").length;\n                }\n                addUsageToTotals(usageTotals, assistantMsg.usage);\n            }\n        }\n        return {\n            sessionFile: this.sessionFile,\n            sessionId: this.sessionId,\n            userMessages,\n            assistantMessages,\n            toolCalls,\n            toolResults,\n            totalMessages,\n            tokens: {\n                input: usageTotals.input,\n                output: usageTotals.output,\n                cacheRead: usageTotals.cacheRead,\n                cacheWrite: usageTotals.cacheWrite,\n                total: usageTotals.input + usageTotals.output + usageTotals.cacheRead + usageTotals.cacheWrite,\n            },\n            cost: usageTotals.cost,\n            contextUsage: this.getContextUsage(),\n        };\n    }\n    getContextUsage() {\n        const model = this.model;\n        if (!model)\n            return undefined;\n        const contextWindow = model.contextWindow ?? 0;\n        if (contextWindow <= 0)\n            return undefined;\n        // After compaction, the last assistant usage reflects pre-compaction context size.\n        // We can only trust usage from an assistant that responded after the latest compaction.\n        // If no such assistant exists, context token count is unknown until the next LLM response.\n        const branchEntries = this.sessionManager.getBranch();\n        const latestCompaction = getLatestCompactionEntry(branchEntries);\n        if (latestCompaction) {\n            // Check if there's a valid assistant usage after the compaction boundary\n            const compactionIndex = branchEntries.lastIndexOf(latestCompaction);\n            let hasPostCompactionUsage = false;\n            for (let i = branchEntries.length - 1; i > compactionIndex; i--) {\n                const entry = branchEntries[i];\n                if (entry.type === \"message\" && entry.message.role === \"assistant\") {\n                    const assistant = entry.message;\n                    if (assistant.stopReason !== \"aborted\" && assistant.stopReason !== \"error\") {\n                        const contextTokens = calculateContextTokens(assistant.usage);\n                        if (contextTokens > 0) {\n                            hasPostCompactionUsage = true;\n                            break;\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            if (!hasPostCompactionUsage) {\n                return { tokens: null, contextWindow, percent: null };\n            }\n        }\n        const estimate = estimateContextTokens(this.messages);\n        const percent = (estimate.tokens / contextWindow) * 100;\n        return {\n            tokens: estimate.tokens,\n            contextWindow,\n            percent,\n        };\n    }\n    /**\n     * Export session to HTML.\n     *    /**\n     * Get text content of last assistant message.\n     * Useful for /copy command.\n     * @returns Text content, or undefined if no assistant message exists\n     */\n    getLastAssistantText() {\n        const lastAssistant = this.messages\n            .slice()\n            .reverse()\n            .find((m) => {\n            if (m.role !== \"assistant\")\n    }\n        if (buffer.length > 0) {\n            const event = decodeSseLine(buffer, state);\n            if (event) {\n                yield event;\n            }\n        }\n        const trailingEvent = flushSseEvent(state);\n        if (trailingEvent) {\n            yield trailingEvent;\n        }\n    }\n    finally {\n        reader.releaseLock();\n    }\n}\nasync function* iterateAnthropicEvents(response, signal) {\n    if (!response.body) {\n        throw new Error(\"Attempted to iterate over an Anthropic response with no body\");\n    }\n    let sawMessageStart = false;\n    let sawMessageEnd = false;\n    for await (const sse of iterateSseMessages(response.body, signal)) {\n        if (sse.event === \"error\") {\n            throw new Error(sse.data);\n        }\n        if (!ANTHROPIC_MESSAGE_EVENTS.has(sse.event ?? \"\")) {\n            continue;\n        }\n        try {\n            const event = parseJsonWithRepair(sse.data);\n            if (event.type === \"message_start\") {\n                sawMessageStart = true;\n            }\n            else if (event.type === \"message_stop\") {\n                sawMessageEnd = true;\n            }\n            yield event;\n        }\n        catch (error) {\n            const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\n            throw new Error(`Could not parse Anthropic SSE event ${sse.event}: ${message}; data=${sse.data}; raw=${sse.raw.join(\"\\\\n\")}`);\n        }\n    }\n    if (sawMessageStart && !sawMessageEnd) {\n        throw new Error(\"Anthropic stream ended before message_stop\");\n    }\n}\nexport const stream = (model, context, options) => {\n    const stream = new AssistantMessageEventStream();\n    (async () => {\n        const output = {\n            role: \"assistant\",\n            content: [],\n            api: model.api,\n            provider: model.provider,\n            model: model.id,\n            usage: {\n                input: 0,\n                output: 0,\n                cacheRead: 0,\n                cacheWrite: 0,\n                totalTokens: 0,\n                cost: { input: 0, output: 0, cacheRead: 0, cacheWrite: 0, total: 0 },\n            },\n            stopReason: \"pending\",\n            timestamp: Date.now(),\n        };\n        try {\n            let client;\n            let isOAuth;\n     hasImages,\n                    });\n                }\n                const cacheRetention = resolveCacheRetention(options?.cacheRetention, options?.env);\n                const cacheSessionId = cacheRetention === \"none\" ? undefined : options?.sessionId;\n                const created = createClient(model, apiKey, options?.interleavedThinking ?? true, shouldUseFineGrainedToolStreamingBeta(model, context), options?.headers, options?.fetch, copilotDynamicHeaders, cacheSessionId);\n                client = created.client;\n                isOAuth = event.message.usage.output_tokens || 0;\n                    output.usage.cacheRead = event.message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens || 0;\n                    output.usage.cacheWrite = event.message.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens || 0;\n                    output.usage.cacheWrite1h = event.message.usage.cache_creation?.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens || 0;\n                    //               if (event.content_block.type === \"text\") {\n                        const block = {\n                            type: \"text\",\n                            text: event.content_block.text ?? \"\",\n                            index: event.index,\n                        };\n                        output.content.push(block);\n                        stream.push({ type: \"text_start\", contentIndex: output.content.length - 1, partial: output });\n                    }\n                    else if (event.content_block.type === \"thinking\") {\n                        const block = {\n                            type: \"thinking\",\n                            thinking: event.content_block.thinking ?? \"\",\n                            thinkingSignature: event.content_block.signature ?? \"\",\n                            index: event.index,\n                        };\n                        output.content.push(block);\n                        stream.push({ type: \"thinking_start\", contentIndex: output.content.length - 1, partial: output });\n                    }\n                    else if (event.content_block.type ===                     };\n                        output.content.push(block);\n                        stream.push({ type: \"toolcall_start\", contentIndex: output.content.length - 1, partial: output });\n                    }\n                }\n                else if (event.type === \"content_block_delta\") {\n                    if (event.delta.type === \"text_delta\") {\n                        const index = blocks.findIndex((b) => b.index === event.index);\n                        const block = blocks[index];\n                        if (block && block.type === \"text\") {\n                            block.text += event.delta.text;\n                            stream.push({\n                                type: \"text_delta\",\n                                contentIndex: index,\n                                delta: event.delta.text,\n                                partial: output,\n                            });\n                        }\n                    }\n                    else if (event.delta.type === \"thinking_delta\") {\n                        const index = blocks.findIndex((b) => b.index === event.index);\n                        const block =                             type: \"thinking_delta\",\n                                contentIndex: index,\n                                delta: event.delta.thinking,\n                 block.partialJson += event.delta.partial_json;\n                            block.arguments = parseStreamingJson(block.partialJson);\n                            stream.push({\n                block.thinkingSignature = block.thinkingSignature || \"\";\n                            block.thinkingSignature += event.delta.signature;\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                else if (event.type === \"content_block_stop\") {\n                    const index = blocks.findIndex((b) => b.index === event.index);\n                    const                         type: \"thinking_end\",\n                                contentIndex: index,\n                                content: block.thinking,\n              const stopReasonResult = mapStopReason(event.delta.stop_reason, event.delta.stop_details);\n                        output.stopReason = stopReasonResult.stopReason;\n                        if (stopReasonResult.errorMessage) {\n                            output.errorMessage = stopReasonResult.errorMessage;\n                        }\n                    }\n                    // Only             if (event.usage.input_tokens != null) {\n                            output.usage.input = event.usage.input_tokens;\n                        }\n                        if adaptive thinking.\n * Note: effort \"max\" is available on all adaptive-thinking Claude models, while native\n * \"xhigh\" is only available on Opus 4.7/4.8, Sonnet 5, and Fable 5.\n */\nfunction mapThinkingLevelToEffort(model, level) {\n    const mapped = level ? model.thinkingLevelMap?.[level] : undefined;\n    if (typeof mapped === \"string\")\n        return mapped;\n    switch (level) {\n        case \"minimal\":\n        case \"low\":\n            return \"low\";\n        case \"medium\":\n            return \"medium\";\n        case \"high\":\n            return \"high\";\n        default:\n            return \"high\";\n    }\n}\nexport const streamSimple = (model, context, options) => {\n    assertRequestAuth(model.provider, options?.apiKey, options?.headers);\n    const base = buildBaseOptions(model, context, options, options?.apiKey);\n    if (!options?.reasoning) {\n        return stream(model, context, { ...base, thinkingEnabled: false });\n    }\n    // For models with adaptive thinking: use an effort level.\n    // For older models: use budget-based thinking.\n    if (model.compat?.forceAdaptiveThinking === true) {\n        const effort = mapThinkingLevelToEffort(model, options.reasoning);\n        return stream(model, context, {\n            ...base,\n            thinkingEnabled: true,\n            effort,\n        });\n    }\n    // Undefined means the caller did not request an output cap; let the helper use the model cap.\n    // Do not coerce to 0 here, or the thinking budget would become the entire max_tokens value.\n    const adjusted = adjustMaxTokensForThinking(base.maxTokens, model.maxTokens, options.reasoning, options.thinkingBudgets);\n    const maxTokens = clampMaxTokensToContext(model, context, adjusted.maxTokens);\n    return stream(model, context, {\n        ...base,\n        maxTokens,\n        thinkingEnabled: true,\n        thinkingBudgetTokens: Math.min(adjusted.thinkingBudget, Math.max(0, maxTokens - 1024)),\n    });\n};\nfunction isOAuthToken(apiKey) {\n    return apiKey.includes(\"sk-ant-oat\");\n}\nfunction createClient(model, apiKey, interleavedThinking, useFineGrainedToolStreamingBeta, optionsHeaders, fetch, dynamicHeaders, sessionId) {\n    // Adaptive thinking models have interleaved thinking built in, so skip the beta header.\n    const needsInterleavedBeta = interleavedThinking && model.compat?.forceAdaptiveThinking !== true;\n    const betaFeatures = [];\n    if (useFineGrainedToolStreamingBeta) {\n        betaFeatures.push(FINE_GRAINED_TOOL_STREAMING_BETA);\n    }\n    if (needsInterleavedBeta) {\n        betaFeatures.push(INTERLEAVED_THINKING_BETA);\n    }\n    // Copilot: Bearer auth, selective betas.\n    if (model.provider === \"github-copilot\") {\n        const client = new Anthropic({\n            apiKey: null,\n            authToken: apiKey ?? null,\n            baseURL: model.baseUrl,\n            dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true,\n            fetch,\n            defaultHeaders: mergeHeaders({\n                accept: \"application/json\",\n                \"anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access\": \"true\",\n                ...(betaFeatures.length > 0 ? { \"anthropic-beta\": betaFeatures.join(\",\") } : {}),\n            }, model.headers, dynamicHeaders, optionsHeaders),\n        });\n        return { client, isOAuthToken: false };\n    }\n    // OAuth: Bearer auth, Claude Code identity headers\n    if (apiKey && isOAuthToken(apiKey)) {\n        const client = new Anthropic({\n            apiKey: null,\n            authToken: apiKey,\n            baseURL: model.baseUrl,\n            dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true,\n            fetch,\n            defaultHeaders: mergeHeaders({\n                accept: \"application/json\",\n                \"anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access\": \"true\",\n                \"anthropic-beta\": [\"claude-code-20250219\", \"oauth-2025-04-20\", ...betaFeatures].join(\",\"),\n                \"user-agent\": `claude-cli/${claudeCodeVersion}`,\n                \"x-app\": optionsHeaders);\n    const client = new Anthropic({\n        apiKey: apiKey ?? null,\n        authToken: null,\n        baseURL: model.baseUrl,\n        dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true,\n        fetch,\n        defaultHeaders,\n    });\n    return { client, isOAuthToken: false };\n}\nfunction buildParams(model, context, isOAuthToken, options) {\n    const { cacheControl } = getCacheControl(model, options?.cacheRetention, options?.env);\n    const compat = getAnthropicCompat(model);\n    const transformedMessages = transformMessages(context.messages, model, normalizeToolCallId);\n    const normalizeToolName = isOAuthToken ? toClaudeCodeName : (name) => name;\n    const toolPlacement = splitDeferredTools({ ...context, messages: transformedMessages }, compat.supportsToolReferences, normalizeToolName);\n    let immediateTools = toolPlacement.immediate;\n    let deferredTools = [...toolPlacement.deferred.values()];\n    if (immediateTools.length === 0 && deferredTools.length > 0) {\n        immediateTools = deferredTools;\n        deferredTools = [];\n    }\n    const deferredToolNames = new Set(deferredTools.map((tool) => normalizeToolName(tool.name)));\n    const params = {\n        model: model.id,\n        messages: convertMessages(transformedMessages, isOAuthToken, cacheControl, compat.allowEmptySignature, deferredToolNames, normalizeToolName),\n        max_tokens: options?.maxTokens ?? model.maxTokens,\n        stream: true,\n    };\n    // For OAuth tokens, we MUST include Claude Code identity\n    if (isOAuthToken) {\n        params.system = [\n            {\n                type: \"text\",\n                text: \"You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.\",\n                ...(cacheControl ? { cache_control: cacheControl } : {}),\n            },\n        ];\n        if (context.systemPrompt) {\n            params.system.push({\n                type: \"text\",\n                text: sanitizeSurrogates(context.systemPrompt),\n                ...(cacheControl ? { cache_control: cacheControl } : {}),\n            });\n        }\n    }\n    else if (context.systemPrompt) {\n        // Add cache control to system prompt for non-OAuth tokens\n        params.system = [\n            {\n                type: \"text\",\n                text: sanitizeSurrogates(context.systemPrompt),\n                ...(cacheControl ? { cache_control: cacheControl } : {}),\n            },\n        ];\n    }\n    // Temperature is incompatible with extended thinking and unsupported on Claude Opus 4.7+.\n    if (options?.temperature !== undefined && !options?.thinkingEnabled && compat.supportsTemperature) {\n        params.temperature = options.temperature;\n    }\n    if (immediateTools.length > 0 || deferredTools.length > 0) {\n        params.tools = [\n            ...convertTools(immediateTools, isOAuthToken, compat.supportsEagerToolInputStreaming, compat.supportsStrictTools, compat.supportsCacheControlOnTools ? cacheControl : undefined),\n            ...convertTools(deferredTools, isOAuthToken, compat.supportsEagerToolInputStreaming, compat.supportsStrictTools, undefined, true),\n        ];\n    }\n    // Configure thinking mode: adaptive, budget-based, or explicitly disabled.\n    if (model.reasoning) {\n        if (options?.thinkingEnabled) {\n            // Default to \"summarized\" so Opus 4.7 and Mythos Preview behave like\n            // older Claude 4 models (whose API default is also \"summarized\").\n            const display = options.thinkingDisplay ?? \"summarized\";\n            if (model.compat?.forceAdaptiveThinking === true) {\n                // Adaptive thinking: Claude decides when and how much to think.\n                params.thinking = { type: \"adaptive\", display };\n                if (options.effort) {\n                    // The Anthropic SDK types can lag newly supported effort values such as \"xhigh\".\n                    params.output_config =\n                        options.effort === \"xhigh\"\n                            ? { effort: options.effort }\n                            : { effort: options.effort };\n                }\n            }\n            else {\n                // Budget-based thinking for older models\n                params.thinking = {\n                    type: \"enabled\",\n                    budget_tokens: options.thinkingBudgetTokens || 1024,\n                    display,\n                };\n            }\n        }\n        else if (options?.thinkingEnabled === false && model.thinkingLevelMap?.off !== null) {\n            params.thinking = { type: \"disabled\" };\n        }\n    }\n    if (options?.metadata) {\n        const userId = options.metadata.user_id;\n        if (typeof userId === \"string\") {\n            params.metadata = { user_id: userId };\n        }\n    }\n    if (options?.toolChoice) {\n        if (typeof options.toolChoice === \"string\") {\n            params.tool_choice = { type: options.toolChoice };\n        }\n        else {\n            params.tool_choice = options.toolChoice;\n        }\n    }\n    return params;\n}\n// Normalize tool call IDs to match Anthropic's required pattern and length\nfunction normalizeToolCallId(id) {\n    return id.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, \"_\").slice(0, 64);\n}\nfunction convertToolResult(msg, isOAuthToken, deferredToolNames, loadedToolNames, normalizeToolName) {\n    const references = [];\n    for (const name of msg.addedToolNames ?? []) {\n        const normalizedName = normalizeToolName(name);\n        if (!deferredToolNames.has(normalizedName) || loadedToolNames.has(normalizedName))\n            continue;\n        loadedToolNames.add(normalizedName);\n        references.push({\n            type: \"tool_reference\",\n            tool_name: isOAuthToken ? toClaudeCodeName(name) : name,\n        });\n    }\n    const convertedContent = convertContentBlocks(msg.content);\n    // Anthropic rejects tool references mixed with ordinary tool-result content.\n    return {\n        toolResult: {\n            type: \"tool_result\",\n            tool_use_id: msg.toolCallId,\n            content: references.length > 0 ? references : convertedContent,\n            is_error: msg.isError,\n        },\n        siblingContent: references.length === 0\n            ? []\n            : typeof convertedContent === \"string\"\n                ? [{ type: \"text\", text: convertedContent }]\n                : convertedContent,\n    };\n}\nfunction convertMessages(transformedMessages, isOAuthToken, cacheControl, allowEmptySignature = false, deferredToolNames = new Set(), normalizeToolName = (name) => name) {\n    const params = [];\n    const loadedToolNames = new Set();\n    for (let i = 0; i < transformedMessages.length; i++) {\n        const msg = transformedMessages[i];\n        if (msg.role === \"user\") {\n            if (typeof msg.content === \"string\") {\n                if (msg.content.trim().length > 0) {\n                    params.push({\n                        role: \"user\",\n                        content: sanitizeSurrogates(msg.content),\n                    });\n                }\n            }\n            else {\n                const blocks = msg.content.map((item) => {\n                    if (item.type === \"text\") {\n                        return {\n                            type: \"text\",\n                            text: sanitizeSurrogates(item.text),\n                        };\n                    }\n                    else {\n                        return {\n                            type: \"image\",\n                            source: {\n                                type: \"base64\",\n                                media_type: item.mimeType,\n                                data: item.data,\n                            },\n                        };\n                    }\n                });\n                const filteredBlocks = blocks.filter((b) => {\n                    if (b.type === \"text\") {\n                        return b.text.trim().length > 0;\n                    }\n                    return true;\n                });\n                if (filteredBlocks.length === 0)\n                    continue;\n                params.push({\n                    role: \"user\",\n                    content: filteredBlocks,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n        else if (msg.role === \"assistant\") {\n            const blocks = [];\n            for (const block of msg.content) {\n                if (block.type === \"text\") {\n                    if (block.text.trim().length === 0)\n                        continue;\n                    blocks.push({\n                        type: \"text\",\n                        text: sanitizeSurrogates(block.text),\n                    });\n                }\n                else if (block.type === \"thinking\") {\n                    // Redacted thinking: pass the opaque payload back as redacted_thinking\n                    if (block.redacted) {\n                        blocks.push({\n                            type: \"redacted_thinking\",\n                            data: block.thinkingSignature,\n                        });\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    const thinkingSignature = block.thinkingSignature;\n                    const hasThinkingSignature = !!thinkingSignature && thinkingSignature.trim().length > 0;\n                    if (block.thinking.trim().length === 0 && !hasThinkingSignature)\n                        continue;\n                    // If thinking signature is missing/empty (e.g., from aborted stream),\n                    // convert to plain text for Anthropic. Some compatible providers emit\n                    // and accept empty signatures, so let marked models preserve the block.\n                    if (!hasThinkingSignature) {\n                        blocks.push(allowEmptySignature\n                            ? {\n                                type: \"thinking\",\n                                thinking: sanitizeSurrogates(block.thinking),\n                                signature: \"\",\n                            }\n                            : {\n                                type: \"text\",\n                                text: sanitizeSurrogates(block.thinking),\n                            });\n                    }\n                    else {\n                        blocks.push({\n                            type: \"thinking\",\n                            thinking: sanitizeSurrogates(block.thinking),\n                            signature: thinkingSignature,\n                        });\n                    }\n                }\n                else if (block.type === \"toolCall\") {\n                    blocks.push({\n                        type: \"tool_use\",\n                        id: block.id,\n                        name: isOAuthToken ? toClaudeCodeName(block.name) : block.name,\n                        input: block.arguments ?? {},\n                    });\n                }\n            }\n            if (blocks.length === 0)\n                continue;\n            params.push({\n                role: \"assistant\",\n                content: blocks,\n            });\n        }\n        else if (msg.role === \"toolResult\") {\n            // Collect all consecutive toolResult messages, needed for z.ai Anthropic endpoint.\n            const toolResults = [];\n            const siblingContent = [];\n            let j = i;\n            while (j < transformedMessages.length && transformedMessages[j].role === \"toolResult\") {\n                const converted = convertToolResult(transformedMessages[j], isOAuthToken, deferredToolNames, loadedToolNames, normalizeToolName);\n                toolResults.push(converted.toolResult);\n                siblingContent.push(...converted.siblingContent);\n                j++;\n            }\n            // Skip the messages we've already processed.\n            i = j - 1;\n            // Displaced \"\\r\\n\" : \"\\n\";\n}\nexport function normalizeToLF(text) {\n    return text.replace(/\\r\\n/g, \"\\n\").replace(/\\r/g, \"\\n\");\n}\nexport function restoreLineEndings(text, ending) {\n    return ending === \"\\r\\n\" ? text.replace(/\\n/g, \"\\r\\n\") : text;\n}\n/**\n * Normalize text for fuzzy matching. Applies progressive transformations:\n * - Strip trailing whitespace from each line\n * - Normalize smart quotes to ASCII equivalents\n * - Normalize Unicode dashes/hyphens to ASCII hyphen\n * - Normalize special Unicode spaces to regular space\n */\nexport function normalizeForFuzzyMatch(text) {\n    return (text\n        .normalize(\"NFKC\")\n        // Strip trailing whitespace per line\n        .split(\"\\n\")\n        .map((line) => line.trimEnd())\n        .join(\"\\n\")\n        // Smart single quotes \u2192 '\n        .replace(/[\\u2018\\u2019\\u201A\\u201B]/g, \"'\")\n        // Smart double quotes \u2192 \"\n        .replace(/[\\u201C\\u201D\\u201E\\u201F]/g, '\"')\n        // Various dashes/hyphens \u2192 -\n        // U+2010 hyphen, U+2011 non-breaking hyphen, U+2012 figure dash,\n        // U+2013 en-dash, U+2014 em-dash, U+2015 horizontal bar, U+2212 minus\n        .replace(/[\\u2010\\u2011\\u2012\\u2013\\u2014\\u2015\\u2212]/g, \"-\")\n        // Special spaces \u2192 regular space\n        // U+00A0 NBSP, U+2002-U+200A various spaces, U+202F narrow NBSP,\n        // U+205F medium math space, U+3000 ideographic space\n        .replace(/[\\u00A0\\u2002-\\u200A\\u202F\\u205F\\u3000]/g, \" \"));\n}\nfunction splitLinesWithEndings(content) {\n    return content.match(/[^\\n]*\\n|[^\\n]+/g) ?? [];\n}\nfunction getLineSpans(content) {\n    let offset = 0;\n    return splitLinesWithEndings(content).map((line) => {\n        const span = { start: offset, end: offset + line.length };\n        offset = span.end;\n        return span;\n    });\n}\nfunction getReplacementLineRange(lines, replacement) {\n    const replacementStart = replacement.matchIndex;\n    const replacementEnd = replacement.matchIndex + replacement.matchLength;\n    let startLine = -1;\n    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {\n        const line = lines[i];\n        if (replacementStart >= line.start && replacementStart < line.end) {\n            startLine = i;\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    if (startLine === -1) {\n        throw new Error(\"Replacement range is outside the base content.\");\n    }\n    let endLine = startLine;\n    while (endLine < lines.length && lines[endLine].end < replacementEnd) {\n        endLine++;\n    }\n    if (endLine >= lines.length) {\n        throw new Error(\"Replacement range is outside the base content.\");\n    }\n    return { startLine, endLine: endLine + 1 };\n}\nfunction applyReplacements(content, replacements, offset = 0) {\n    let result = content;\n    for (let i = replacements.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {\n        const replacement = replacements[i];\n        const matchIndex = replacement.matchIndex - offset;\n        result =\n            result.substring(0, matchIndex) + replacement.newText + result.substring(matchIndex + replacement.matchLength);\n    }\n    return result;\n}\n/**\n * Apply replacements matched against `baseContent` to `originalContent` while\n * preserving unchanged line blocks from the original.\n *\n * This is useful when `baseContent` is a normalized view of the original. Each\n * replacement is widened to the lines it actually touches, those touched lines\n * are rewritten from the normalized base, and all other lines are copied back\n * from `originalContent`. The actual replacement ranges drive preservation so\n * duplicate normalized lines cannot be aligned to the wrong occurrence.\n */\nexport function applyReplacementsPreservingUnchangedLines(originalContent, baseContent, replacements) {\n    const originalLines = splitLinesWithEndings(originalContent);\n    const baseLines = getLineSpans(baseContent);\n    if (originalLines.length !== baseLines.length) {\n        throw new Error(\"Cannot preserve unchanged lines because the base content has a different line count.\");\n    }\n    const groups = [];\n    const sortedReplacements = [...replacements].sort((a, b) => a.matchIndex - b.matchIndex);\n    for (const replacement of sortedReplacements) {\n        const range = getReplacementLineRange(baseLines, replacement);\n        const current = groups[groups.length - 1];\n        if (current && range.startLine < current.endLine) {\n            current.endLine = Math.max(current.endLine, range.endLine);\n            current.replacements.push(replacement);\n            continue;\n        }\n        groups.push({ ...range, replacements: [replacement] });\n    }\n    let originalLineIndex = 0;\n    let result = \"\";\n    for (const group of groups) {\n        result += originalLines.slice(originalLineIndex, group.startLine).join(\"\");\n        const groupStartOffset = baseLines[group.startLine].start;\n        const groupEndOffset = baseLines[group.endLine - 1].end;\n        result += applyReplacements(baseContent.slice(groupStartOffset, groupEndOffset), group.replacements, groupStartOffset);\n        originalLineIndex = group.endLine;\n    }\n    result += originalLines.slice(originalLineIndex).join(\"\");\n    return result;\n}\n/**\n * Find oldText in content, trying exact match first, then fuzzy match.\n * When fuzzy matching is used, the returned contentForReplacement is the\n * fuzzy-normalized version of the content (trailing whitespace stripped,\n * Unicode quotes/dashes normalized to ASCII).\n */\nexport function fuzzyFindText(content, oldText) {\n    // Try exact match first\n    const exactIndex = content.indexOf(oldText);\n    if (exactIndex !== -1) {\n        return {\n            found: true,\n            index: exactIndex,\n            matchLength: oldText.length,\n            usedFuzzyMatch: false,\n            contentForReplacement: content,\n        };\n    }\n    // Try fuzzy match - work entirely in normalized space\n    const fuzzyContent = normalizeForFuzzyMatch(content);\n    const fuzzyOldText = normalizeForFuzzyMatch(oldText);\n    const fuzzyIndex = fuzzyContent.indexOf(fuzzyOldText);\n    if (fuzzyIndex === -1) {\n        return {\n            found: false,\n            index: -1,\n            matchLength: 0,\n            usedFuzzyMatch: false,\n            contentForReplacement: content,\n        };\n    }\n    // When fuzzy matching, return offsets in normalized space. Callers can use\n    // the normalized content to compute replacements, then decide how much of\n    // that normalized output should be written back.\n    return {\n        found: true,\n        index: fuzzyIndex,\n        matchLength: fuzzyOldText.length,\n        usedFuzzyMatch: true,\n        contentForReplacement: fuzzyContent,\n    };\n}\n/** Strip UTF-8 BOM if present, return both the BOM (if any) and the text without it */\nexport function stripBom(content) {\n    return content.startsWith(\"\\uFEFF\") ? { bom: \"\\uFEFF\", text: content.slice(1) } : { bom: \"\", text: content };\n}\nfunction countOccurrences(content, oldText) {\n    const fuzzyContent = normalizeForFuzzyMatch(content);\n    const fuzzyOldText = normalizeForFuzzyMatch(oldText);\n    return fuzzyContent.split(fuzzyOldText).length - 1;\n}\nfunction getNotFoundError(path, editIndex, totalEdits) {\n    if (totalEdits === 1) {\n        return new Error(`Could not find the exact text in ${path}. The old text must match exactly including all whitespace and newlines.`);\n    }\n    return new Error(`Could not find edits[${editIndex}] in ${path}. The oldText must match exactly including all whitespace and newlines.`);\n}\nfunction getDuplicateError(path, editIndex, totalEdits, occurrences) {\n    if (totalEdits === 1) {\n        return new Error(`Found ${occurrences} occurrences of the text in ${path}. The text must be unique. Please provide more context to make it unique.`);\n    }\n    return new Error(`Found ${occurrences} occurrences of edits[${editIndex}] in ${path}. Each oldText must be unique. Please provide more context to make it unique.`);\n}\nfunction getEmptyOldTextError(path, editIndex, totalEdits) {\n    if (totalEdits === 1) {\n        return new Error(`oldText must not be empty in ${path}.`);\n    }\n    return new Error(`edits[${editIndex}].oldText must not be empty in ${path}.`);\n}\nfunction getNoChangeError(path, totalEdits) {\n    if (totalEdits === 1) {\n        return new Error(`No changes made to ${path}. The replacement produced identical content. This might indicate an issue with special characters or the text not existing as expected.`);\n    }\n    return new Error(`No changes made to ${path}. The replacements produced identical content.`);\n}\n/**\n * Apply one or more exact-text replacements to LF-normalized content.\n *\n * All edits are matched against the same original content. Replacements are\n * then applied in reverse order so offsets remain stable. If any edit needs\n * fuzzy matching, the operation runs in fuzzy-normalized content space and then\n * overlays those line-level changes onto the original content so unchanged line\n * blocks keep their original bytes.\n */\nexport function applyEditsToNormalizedContent(normalizedContent, edits, path) {\n    const normalizedEdits = edits.map((edit) => ({\n        oldText: normalizeToLF(edit.oldText),\n        newText: normalizeToLF(edit.newText),\n    }));\n    for (let i = 0; i < normalizedEdits.length; i++) {\n        if (normalizedEdits[i].oldText.length === 0) {\n            throw getEmptyOldTextError(path, i, normalizedEdits.length);\n        }\n    }\n    const initialMatches = normalizedEdits.map((edit) => fuzzyFindText(normalizedContent, edit.oldText));\n    const usedFuzzyMatch = initialMatches.some((match) => match.usedFuzzyMatch);\n    const replacementBaseContent = usedFuzzyMatch ? normalizeForFuzzyMatch(normalizedContent) : normalizedContent;\n    const matchedEdits = [];\n    for (let i = 0; i < normalizedEdits.length; i++) {\n        const edit = normalizedEdits[i];\n        const matchResult = fuzzyFindText(replacementBaseContent, edit.oldText);\n        if (!matchResult.found) {\n            throw getNotFoundError(path, i, normalizedEdits.length);\n        }\n        const occurrences = countOccurrences(replacementBaseContent, edit.oldText);\n        if (occurrences > 1) {\n            throw getDuplicateError(path, i, normalizedEdits.length, occurrences);\n        }\n        matchedEdits.push({\n            editIndex: i,\n            matchIndex: matchResult.index,\n            matchLength: matchResult.matchLength,\n            newText: edit.newText,\n        });\n    }\n    matchedEdits.sort((a, b) => a.matchIndex - b.matchIndex);\n    for (let i = 1; i < matchedEdits.length; i++) {\n        const previous = matchedEdits[i - 1];\n        const current = matchedEdits[i];\n        if (previous.matchIndex + previous.matchLength > current.matchIndex) {\n            throw new Error(`edits[${previous.editIndex}] and edits[${current.editIndex}] overlap in ${path}. Merge them into one edit or target disjoint regions.`);\n        }\n    }\n    const baseContent = normalizedContent;\n    const newContent = usedFuzzyMatch\n        ? applyReplacementsPreservingUnchangedLines(normalizedContent, replacementBaseContent, matchedEdits)\n        : applyReplacements(replacementBaseContent, matchedEdits);\n    if (baseContent === newContent) {\n        throw getNoChangeError(path, normalizedEdits.length);\n    }\n    return { baseContent, newContent };\n}\n/** Generate a standard unified patch. */\nexport function generateUnifiedPatch(path, oldContent, newContent, contextLines = 4) {\n    return Diff.createTwoFilesPatch(path, path, oldContent, newContent, undefined, undefined, {\n        context: contextLines,\n        headerOptions: Diff.FILE_HEADERS_ONLY,\n    });\n}\n/**\n * Generate a display-oriented diff string with line numbers and context.\n * Returns both the diff string and the first changed line number (in the new file).\n */\nexport function generateDiffString(oldContent, newContent, contextLines = 4) {\n    const parts = Diff.diffLines(oldContent, newContent);\n    const output = [];\n    const oldLines = oldContent.split(\"\\n\");\n    const newLines = newContent.split(\"\\n\");\n    const maxLineNum = Math.max(oldLines.length, newLines.length);\n    const lineNumWidth = String(maxLineNum).length;\n    let oldLineNum = 1;\n    let newLineNum = 1;\n    let lastWasChange = false;\n    let firstChangedLine;\n    for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {\n        const part = parts[i];\n        const raw = part.value.split(\"\\n\");\n        if (raw[raw.length - 1] === \"\") {\n            raw.pop();\n        }\n        if (part.added || part.removed) {\n            // Capture the first changed line (in the new file)\n            if (firstChangedLine === undefined) {\n                firstChangedLine = newLineNum;\n            }\n            // Show the change\n            for (const line of raw) {\n                if (part.added) {\n                    const lineNum = String(newLineNum).padStart(lineNumWidth, \" \");\n                    output.push(`+${lineNum} ${line}`);\n                    newLineNum++;\n                }\n                else {\n                    // removed\n                    const lineNum = String(oldLineNum).padStart(lineNumWidth, \" \");\n                    output.push(`-${lineNum} ${line}`);\n                    oldLineNum++;\n                }\n            }\n            lastWasChange = true;\n        }\n        else {\n            // Context lines - only show a few before/after changes\n            const nextPartIsChange = i < parts.length - 1 && (parts[i + 1].added || parts[i + 1].removed);\n            const hasLeadingChange = lastWasChange;\n            const hasTrailingChange = nextPartIsChange;\n            if (hasLeadingChange && hasTrailingChange) {\n                if (raw.length <= contextLines * 2) {\n                    for (const line of raw) {\n                        const lineNum = String(oldLineNum).padStart(lineNumWidth, \" \");\n                        output.push(` ${lineNum} ${line}`);\n                        oldLineNum++;\n                        newLineNum++;\n                    }\n                }\n                else {\n                    const leadingLines = raw.slice(0, contextLines);\n                    const trailingLines = raw.slice(raw.length - contextLines);\n                    const skippedLines = raw.length - leadingLines.length - trailingLines.length;\n                    for (const line of leadingLines) {\n                        const lineNum = String(oldLineNum).padStart(lineNumWidth, \" \");\n                        output.push(` ${lineNum} ${line}`);\n                        oldLineNum++;\n                        newLineNum++;\n                    }\n                    output.push(` ${\"\".padStart(lineNumWidth, \" \")} ...`);\n                    oldLineNum += skippedLines;\n                    newLineNum += skippedLines;\n                    for (const line of trailingLines) {\n                        const lineNum = String(oldLineNum).padStart(lineNumWidth, \" \");\n                        output.push(` ${lineNum} ${line}`);\n                        oldLineNum++;\n                        newLineNum++;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            else if (hasLeadingChange) {\n                const shownLines = raw.slice(0, contextLines);\n                const skippedLines = raw.length - shownLines.length;\n                for (const line of shownLines) {\n                    const lineNum = String(oldLineNum).padStart(lineNumWidth, \" \");\n                    output.push(` ${lineNum} ${line}`);\n                    oldLineNum++;\n                    newLineNum++;\n                }\n                if (skippedLines > 0) {\n                    output.push(` ${\"\".padStart(lineNumWidth, \" \")} ...`);\n                    oldLineNum += skippedLines;\n                    newLineNum += skippedLines;\n                }\n            }\n            else if (hasTrailingChange) {\n                const skippedLines = Math.max(0, raw.length - contextLines);\n                if (skippedLines > 0) {\n                    output.push(` ${\"\".padStart(lineNumWidth, \" \")} ...`);\n                    oldLineNum += skippedLines;\n                    newLineNum += skippedLines;\n                }\n                for (const line of raw.slice(skippedLines)) {\n                    const lineNum = String(oldLineNum).padStart(lineNumWidth, \" \");\n                    output.push(` ${lineNum} ${line}`);\n                    oldLineNum++;\n                    newLineNum++;\n                }\n            }\n            else {\n                // Skip these context lines entirely\n                oldLineNum += raw.length;\n                newLineNum += raw.length;\n            }\n            lastWasChange = false;\n        }\n    }\n    return { diff: output.join(\"\\n\"), firstChangedLine };\n}\n/**\n * Compute the diff for one or more edit operations without applying them.\n * Used for preview rendering in the TUI before the tool executes.\n */\nexport async function computeEditsDiff(path, edits, cwd) {\n    const absolutePath = resolveToCwd(path, cwd);\n    try {\n        // Check if file exists and is readable\n        try {\n            await access(absolutePath, constants.R_OK);\n        }\n        catch (error) {\n            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error && \"code\" in error ? `Error code: ${error.code}` : String(error);\n            return { error: `Could not edit file: ${path}. ${errorMessage}.` };\n        }\n        // Read the file\n        const rawContent = await readFile(absolutePath, \"utf-8\");\n        // Strip BOM before matching (LLM won't include invisible BOM in oldText)\n        const { text: content } = stripBom(rawContent);\n        const normalizedContent = normalizeToLF(content);\n        const { baseContent, newContent } = applyEditsToNormalizedContent(normalizedContent, edits, path);\n        // Generate the diff\n        return generateDiffString(baseContent, newContent);\n    }\n    catch (err) {\n        return { error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) };\n    }\n}\n/**\n * Compute the diff for a single edit operation without applying it.\n * Kept as a convenience wrapper for single-edit callers.\n */\nexport async function computeEditDiff(path, oldText, newText, cwd) {\n    return computeEditsDiff(path, [{ oldText, newText }], cwd);\n}\n//# sourceMappingURL=edit-diff.js.map",
